title: (Senior) Softwareentwickler (m/w/x) Testautomatisierung
description: Projektbeschreibung: Technologie begeistert Sie? Uns auch! Zur Verstärkung unseres Expertenteams bei unserem Kunden aus der Funk- und Kommunikationsbranche suchen wir einen (Senior) Softwareentwickler (m/w/x) Testautomatisierung in Festanstellung bei K-tronik. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie persönlich kennen zu lernen - und gemeinsam mit Leidenschaft und Teamgeist an spannenden Projekten und zukunftsweisenden Technologien zu arbeiten. Aufgaben: Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreibst eine zentrale Testautomatisierungsplattform für komplexe Funkkommunikationssysteme. Du entwickelst die Softwarearchitektur und Automatisierungslogik für ein übergeordnetes End-to-End-Testsystem und treibst dessen Weiterentwicklung voran. Du implementierst CI/CD-basierte Testabläufe, beispielsweise mit Jenkins oder GitLab CI, zur kontinuierlichen Systemverifikation. Du erstellst und pflegst Schnittstellen, APIs und Protokolle zum zu testenden System sowie zu angebundenen Messgeräten, Testständen und externen Systemen. Du entwickelst Lösungen zur automatisierten Erfassung, Ablage, Auswertung und Visualisierung von Mess- und Testergebnissen. Du bindest Testmanagement- und Anforderungswerkzeuge in die Automatisierungsumgebung ein und unterstützt die Reproduzierbarkeit der Ergebnisse durch sauberes Konfigurations-, Versions- und Testdatenmanagement. Qualifikationen: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung für Testautomatisierung mit, insbesondere mit Python und Pytest. Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse im Design und Aufbau automatisierter Testframeworks, Testinfrastrukturen und CI/CD-basierter Umgebungen. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitLab Jobs, Repository-Management sowie Linux-basierten Entwicklungs- und Testumgebungen. Du verfügst über Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Dashboards, Auswertungen und Visualisierungen. Du hast Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken zur Ablage und Auswertung technischer Mess- und Ergebnisdaten. Du bist versiert in der Anbindung von Messgeräten, Testständen oder externen Systemen über geeignete Schnittstellen. Kenntnisse im RF-, Funkkommunikations- oder sicherheitskritischen Umfeld sind von Vorteil. title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
description: 📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer . Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse , vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites. Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique . Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance . Vos missions Votre rôle Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite . Vous êtes à la fois : un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ; un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ; un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents. Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre. Vos principales missions 1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels. Votre périmètre couvre notamment : les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ; les systèmes de secours électrique ; les UPS / onduleurs ; les groupes électrogènes ; les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ; les systèmes de refroidissement ; la protection et la sécurité incendie ; les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées. Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations , et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques. 2 - Sécuriser les opérations L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques. À ce titre, vous : challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ; vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ; identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ; sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ; challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ; pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ; accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ; contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification. Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation , avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service. 3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites. Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels . Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : structurer les processus d'exploitation ; définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ; rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ; mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ; contrôler leur bonne application ; identifier les écarts entre les sites ; proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ; partager les bonnes pratiques ; réaliser des REX multisites ; accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards. La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique. 4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations. Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à : analyser techniquement l'incident ; identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ; apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ; challenger les analyses proposées ; accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ; contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ; participer à la résolution de l'incident ; organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites. Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle. 5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation. Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à : former et accompagner les équipes ; expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ; faire progresser les pratiques ; fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ; accompagner la conduite du changement ; favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites. Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct . 6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs Vous serez capable de : représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ; expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ; présenter les actions mises en œuvre ; répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ; apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures. Une organisation en construction Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré , regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets. L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation. Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec : les responsables de site ; les équipes Facility et Operations ; les équipes projets ; les experts techniques ; les prestataires et partenaires externes ; les fonctions transverses ; les clients majeurs. Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes . Vos compétences Votre profil Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée . Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées. Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée. Votre expertise technique Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment : électricité HT/BT ; systèmes de secours électrique ; UPS / groupes électrogènes ; CVC / HVAC ; refroidissement ; protection incendie ; contrôle-commande ; maintenance des infrastructures critiques. Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes , et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial. Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées. Votre expérience opérationnelle Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante. Vous êtes à l'aise avec : les modes opératoires (MOP) ; la gestion des changements ; l'analyse de risques ; la maintenance préventive et corrective ; la gestion d'incidents critiques ; les audits et contrôles opérationnels ; les REX ; la standardisation des pratiques ; la gestion de prestataires techniques. Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation , de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations. Vos qualités Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne : dotée d'une forte expertise technique ; structurée et rigoureuse ; capable d'analyse et de prise de recul ; pédagogue et capable de transmettre son expertise ; à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ; capable de prendre des décisions et de défendre une position technique ; dotée d'une forte intelligence relationnelle ; capable de s'adapter à différents profils et différents niveaux de maturité ; fédératrice et à l'aise dans un rôle transverse ; capable d'accompagner la conduite du changement. Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante. Avantages Bonus : 2 mois de salaire Déplacements : indemnité de véhicule forfaitaire sur 12 mois de 1 500 € De la participation équivalent à 1-1.5 mois de salaire Astreinte : Poste soumis à l'astreinte (à validation période d'essai) Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Intern - AI Financial Advisory (m/w/d)
description: Über Finton Finton ist eine AI-Native Finance-Beratung, die AI-gestützte Lösungen für den CFO-Bereich konzipiert und implementiert. Unsere Services erbringen wir mit unserer eigenen Software, die den Berater von Projektmanagement über Datenverarbeitung bis zu Datenanalyse und Dashboard-Erstellung durchgängig mit AI unterstützt. Konkret heißt das: Wir setzen auf dem bestehenden ERP, der Buchhaltung und den operativen Systemen des Kunden auf, bringen die Daten zusammen und liefern in kürzester Zeit ein produktives Ergebnis, etwa ein monatliches Management Reporting mit Kommentierung, einen rollierenden 13-Wochen-Cash-Forecast, eine Deckungsbeitrags- und Umsatzanalyse nach Kunden, Produkten oder Projekten oder einen Datenraum und ein Financial Fact Book für eine anstehende Transaktion. Daneben arbeiten wir klassisch beratend: als Sparringspartner des CFO bei Budget, Forecast und Investorenkommunikation, als Interim-Kapazität in der Finanzabteilung und als Unterstützung bei M&A, Fundraising und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitung. Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische und investorenfinanzierte Unternehmen mit typischerweise 10 bis 250 Mio. Euro Umsatz, bei denen das Finance-Team für die Anforderungen von Gesellschaftern und Banken zu klein oder zu manuell aufgestellt ist. Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich. Deine Aufgaben Projektunterstützung: Du arbeitest im Hintergrund in laufenden Kundenprojekten mit: Du bereitest Finanzdaten aus ERP und Buchhaltung auf, baust Auswertungen und Dashboards auf unserer AI-Plattform und lieferst dem Projektteam die Grundlage für das Gespräch mit dem CFO. Finanzmodelle und Analysen: Du wirkst an Finanzmodellen, Cash Forecasts, Deckungsbeitragsanalysen und Unternehmensbewertungen mit und prüfst Daten und Ergebnisse auf Plausibilität. Business Development: Du recherchierst Zielkunden, Investoren und Multiplikatoren, pflegst unsere Lead-Listen und erstellst Angebots- und Pitch-Unterlagen sowie Case Studies. Strategie: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern an strategischen Fragen wie Positionierung, Pricing, neuen Service-Linien und Partnerschaften, von der Analyse bis zur Entscheidungsvorlage. Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse: Du beobachtest Markt, Wettbewerber und AI-Entwicklungen im Finance-Bereich und leitest daraus Empfehlungen für unser Angebot ab. Produktentwicklung: Mit deinem Feedback aus Projektarbeit und Markt hilfst du unserem Technologie-Team, die AI-Plattform weiterzuentwickeln. Eigeninitiative: Du gestaltest mit, statt nur abzuarbeiten, auch bei internen Themen wie Recruiting, Wissensaufbau oder Prozessverbesserung. Das bringst Du mit Studium: Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung mit sehr guten Leistungen, mindestens drei abgeschlossene Semester. Erfahrung: Erste relevante Praxiserfahrung, etwa durch Praktika in Consulting, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Private Equity oder in der Finanzabteilung eines Unternehmens. Handwerk: Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint, Grundverständnis von Bilanz, GuV und Cashflow; erste Berührung mit Finanzmodellen oder Bewertung ist ein Plus. Technologie: Interesse an AI und Prozessautomatisierung im Finanzwesen. Programmierkenntnisse sind kein Muss, aber du willst verstehen, wie unsere Lösungen funktionieren. Analytik: Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein gutes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis. Haltung: Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit und Freude daran, in einem kleinen Team Dinge selbst voranzutreiben. Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Deine ersten Monate bei Finton In den ersten Tagen lernst du unsere Plattform, unsere Projektmethodik und unsere laufenden Mandate kennen und bekommst einen festen Ansprechpartner im Team. Schon in der ersten Woche unterstützt du ein Kundenprojekt aus dem Hintergrund: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust erste Auswertungen und siehst, wie aus Rohdaten ein Reporting für den CFO wird. Nach den ersten Wochen übernimmst du eigene Arbeitspakete, etwa einen Teil eines Finanzmodells, eine Wettbewerbsanalyse oder den Aufbau einer neuen Lead-Liste, und präsentierst deine Ergebnisse direkt den Gründern. Benefits Echte Aufgaben statt Zuschauen: Du arbeitest an realen Projekten, Modellen und Strategiethemen mit und siehst, was mit deiner Arbeit beim Kunden passiert. Kein Kaffeekochen, kein Folienschubsen ohne Kontext. Direkter Draht zu den Gründern: Du bekommst einen festen Mentor aus dem Gründerteam, regelmäßiges Feedback und Einblick, wie eine Beratung aufgebaut und geführt wird. Perspektive: Wer überzeugt, hat die Option, nach dem Praktikum in Vollzeit bei uns einzusteigen. Vergütung: Eine faire Praktikumsvergütung, die deine Erfahrung berücksichtigt. Technologie: Du arbeitest mit unserer eigenen AI-Plattform statt mit Excel-Handarbeit und lernst, wie Finance- und Beratungsarbeit in den nächsten Jahren aussehen wird. Standort Köln: Unser Büro liegt am Friesenplatz, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort, weil du so am schnellsten lernst und wir als kleines Team schnell entscheiden wollen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören dazu. Ausstattung und Extras: Firmenlaptop, Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Fitnessabo, kostenlose Getränke im Büro, lockere Kleiderordnung sowie regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien. Bewerbung Wenn du diesen Weg mitgestalten willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über die Plattform. Ein Lebenslauf reicht uns für den Anfang; ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).
  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.
  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.
  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.
  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.
  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.
  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.
  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.
  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.
  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.
  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.
  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).
  • Proficiency in REST API design, JSON/XML data structures, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and API authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT).
  • Experience reading and consuming API documentation across enterprise SaaS platforms, including data transformation and field mapping logic.
  • Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance. 
  • Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.
  • Fluency in German and English is required 

Our Recruiting Process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

 

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. Please click here to learn more.

  • 1+ years of growing and expanding existing customer accounts

Building on the success of our Australia-based sales team, Contentful is expanding our Enterprise Account Executive team across Australia  As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive Contentful’s growth by leading the full end-to-end sales cycle—from prospecting to closing—across both new and existing enterprise accounts ($1B+).   • Strong communication, proposal development, and presentation skills, with an ability to engage and influence both technical and business decision-makers.
  • Understanding of sales-led growth motions and enterprise software sales best practices.

description: Contexte : ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe. ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in multi-modal reinforcement learning to advance next-generation intelligent systems. Your work will focus on optimizing decision-making and adaptive behavior across integrated data modalities such as text, images and audio to deliver enhanced intelligence, robust performance, and domain-specific capabilities for real-world challenges. You will develop and scale reinforcement learning techniques within complex multi-modal architectures, including diffusion-based generative models and autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, as well as resource-efficient models designed for constrained hardware environments. This includes conducting research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, spanning diffusion models for image autoregressive models for multimodal reasoning, and unified multimodal frameworks. You are expected to have deep expertise in designing multi-modal reinforcement learning systems and a strong background in advanced model architectures, with a hands-on, research-driven approach to building and deploying novel algorithms and training frameworks. You will design and develop RL infrastructure and reward modeling strategies to enable efficient large-scale training, improve training stability, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes. Your responsibilities also include curating multi-modal simulation environments and training datasets, improving baseline policy performance across modalities, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in multi-modal learning and reward optimization. In addition, you will explore next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more directly and effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of unlocking superior, domain-adapted AI performance in dynamic, real-world environments. Design and conduct rigorous benchmarking and evaluation protocols to measure model performance, track progress against baselines, and validate improvements across multimodal tasks. Analyze and optimize policy performance across modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, and cross-modal alignment. Investigate and develop next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of achieving superior state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Strong proficiency in PyTorch and deep learning frameworks for vision and multimodal AI, with hands-on experience building end-to-end RL pipelines covering simulation, training, evaluation, and deployment in production-grade systems. Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in multi-modal reinforcement learning to advance next-generation intelligent systems. Your work will focus on optimizing decision-making and adaptive behavior across integrated data modalities such as text, images and audio to deliver enhanced intelligence, robust performance, and domain-specific capabilities for real-world challenges. You will develop and scale reinforcement learning techniques within complex multi-modal architectures, including diffusion-based generative models and autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, as well as resource-efficient models designed for constrained hardware environments. This includes conducting research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, spanning diffusion models for image autoregressive models for multimodal reasoning, and unified multimodal frameworks.

You are expected to have deep expertise in designing multi-modal reinforcement learning systems and a strong background in advanced model architectures, with a hands-on, research-driven approach to building and deploying novel algorithms and training frameworks. You will design and develop RL infrastructure and reward modeling strategies to enable efficient large-scale training, improve training stability, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes. Your responsibilities also include curating multi-modal simulation environments and training datasets, improving baseline policy performance across modalities, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in multi-modal learning and reward optimization. In addition, you will explore next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more directly and effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of unlocking superior, domain-adapted AI performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

  • Conduct research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified frameworks that integrate multiple modalities.

  • Design and build reinforcement learning infrastructure that supports scalable, distributed training across multimodal systems while maintaining efficiency and reliability.

  • Develop and refine reward modeling strategies that improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create and curate multimodal simulation environments and datasets to support robust training, evaluation, and benchmarking of reinforcement learning systems.

  • Design and conduct rigorous benchmarking and evaluation protocols to measure model performance, track progress against baselines, and validate improvements across multimodal tasks.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate and develop next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of achieving superior state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

  • Publish research findings in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.


  • A Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field is required; a PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, or a closely related discipline is preferred, along with a strong track record of AI research and publications in top-tier conferences.

  • Proven experience running large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online RL settings, with demonstrated impact on domain-specific decision-making and measurable improvements in policy performance.

  • Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization methods applied to vision and multimodal learning problems, with a focus on improving policy stability, exploration, and sample efficiency in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

  • Strong proficiency in PyTorch and deep learning frameworks for vision and multimodal AI, with hands-on experience building end-to-end RL pipelines covering simulation, training, evaluation, and deployment in production-grade systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to solve core RL challenges in multimodal and vision tasks, such as sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation tradeoffs, and training instability, along with experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on algorithmic improvements to advance agent performance.

  • Proven track record of research publications in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

Our portfolio includes: Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams. Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.


About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

Product Owner - Sales & Marketing, Acquisition Technology

Hybrid in London, UK

We're looking for a Product Owner to join the Acquitech team.

You'll own the roadmap for the team behind iwoca's acquisition data, technology and models.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star service ensure business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they power.

The team

Acquitech builds and maintains the data infrastructure behind iwoca's direct acquisition channels. The team's aim is to get the right data to the right places – so ad platforms find businesses worth reaching, analysts trust the reports they build, and the sales team knows who to call first.

The team works across four areas:

  • Tracking and attribution. Recording every lead and sign-up accurately, and sending conversion data back to ad platforms so their algorithms improve over time.

  • Customer value prediction. Building models that estimate a potential customer's expected value, used to guide where marketing spends, who receives direct mail and which businesses a salesperson prioritises.

  • The data layer. Providing a clear, trusted foundation so analysts and channel managers can build reporting without second-guessing the numbers.

  • Team tooling and automation. Building tools and automated workflows, from automating sales task assignment to running LLM analysis on sales calls so the team can review performance at scale.

The team is small – three engineers, two data scientists and you – with the senior engineer sharing the day-to-day leadership. You'll report to a Senior Product Owner in an adjacent team.

The role

As Product Owner in Acquitech, you'll turn requests from marketing and sales into well-scoped work the team can deliver, and own the roadmap. You'll have real ownership of systems that directly shape acquisition spend, and the space to move quickly in a small, capable team. The work mixes delivery – compliance sign-offs, ad platform integrations and product changes – with discovery cycles where you prototype and test ideas quickly.

You'll become the go-to person for Acquitech systems and processes, and you'll use AI to multiply what a small team can deliver – from prototyping ideas to automating workflows for the team and its stakeholders.

  • Roadmap and priorities. You'll own priorities across Acquitech's work, writing clear requirements and seeing them through to release. You'll set direction with the Head of Direct Acquisition and the channel leads who depend on the team.

  • Tracking and ad platform integrations. You'll lead the team's work on conversion tracking, custom audiences and API migrations. You'll own the product change documentation that comes with them, working through Compliance, Data Privacy and Legal.

  • Discovery. You'll run discovery work to find new opportunities, using AI to prototype and test ideas quickly, and bring findings back to the wider business – for example through weekly learning sessions.

  • Ways of working. You'll run the team's rhythms – stand-ups, retros and monthly reviews – and set clear quarterly goals.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Product ownership. You've worked in a product role, managing several projects end to end – writing requirements, owning priorities and being accountable for results.

  • Data literacy. You use data to diagnose problems, size opportunities and evaluate whether a release delivered what you hoped.

  • Technical fluency. You can discuss trade-offs with engineers around APIs, tracking pipelines and data flows. You follow the argument without needing everything translated.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly. You adapt technical detail for commercial colleagues and commercial context for engineers.

  • Leadership. You're comfortable running stand-ups and retros, setting quarterly goals and keeping priorities clear.

  • AI leverage. You've built AI workflows, or used AI to produce specs, analysis, or prototypes beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

Bonus:

  • Marketing technology. You've worked with tools such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Ads or Meta Ads, or on conversion tracking and attribution.

  • Analytics tools. You've used Looker, Amplitude or a similar analytics platform to build or maintain reporting.

  • Data pipelines. You understand ETL concepts or database architecture.

  • Data science collaboration. You've worked alongside data scientists or contributed to a modelling project.

  • Regulated products. You've worked in fintech, lending or another regulated product area.

The salary

We expect to pay from £50,000 to £70,000 for this role. We're open-minded, so include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every team member always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days' holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we've been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Financial Controller
description: What is Flagstone? Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work. Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage. A feel for our culture: To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth. That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it. We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three. But enough about us. Let’s talk about you. Does this sound like you? You’re a qualified accountant who enjoys being close to the numbers and close to the business. raw.title: Financial Controller
raw.description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

 

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

 

Does this sound like you?

You’re a qualified accountant who enjoys being close to the numbers and close to the business. You’ve run month-end, the balance sheet, and financial controls end to end, and you know what good controls look like in both complex and fast-growing environments. You stay calm under pressure, explain finance simply to people outside it, and you’re always looking for smarter, more automated ways of working.

 

What you'll do

You’ll run Flagstone’s day-to-day core finance operations, making sure our numbers are accurate, controlled, and on time. Reporting to the Finance Director, you’ll own the month-end close, the balance sheet, and day-to-day financial control, while our FP&A team owns planning and forecasting. As the Finance Director’s right hand, you’ll run the detail so they can focus on supporting the CFO, the Board, and commercial decisions. It’s a hands-on role that will grow in scope and complexity as Flagstone scales.

This will include:

  • Running the month-end close end to end and delivering accurate, timely management accounts

  • Keeping a clean, fully supported balance sheet, with reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, and journals in order

  • Making sure direct-to-consumer and business revenue is recorded accurately, with commercial terms in contracts correctly reflected in revenue and cash

  • Managing daily cash and liquidity monitoring, so the Finance Director always has a clear view of our position

  • Owning financial controls that fit our scale and regulatory environment, including our obligations as an Authorised Payment Institution

  • Preparing for the annual statutory audit, and delivering VAT returns, tax compliance, Companies House filings, and HMRC reporting

  • Making sure monthly payroll and benefits are processed accurately, supported by clear standard operating procedures

  • Working closely with teams across the business, including Product and Engineering on software capitalisation, Compliance, People, Legal, Sales, Data, and Transaction Operations

  • Deputising for the Finance Director and supporting the team during peak periods

  • Using automation and AI to shorten the close, reduce manual work, and help build a technology-enabled finance function

 
 

What you'll bring

  • ACA or ACCA qualified, with solid post-qualified experience running month-end, balance sheet, and financial controls

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge and the pace to deliver to tight deadlines

  • Experience in a complex environment with good controls discipline, as well as in a smaller, fast-growing business

  • Experience with a modern cloud ERP system, with Workday Financials a significant advantage

  • A sharp eye for detail and good commercial awareness, spotting when numbers and contracts differ and following it through

  • Strong organisation, with the ability to manage competing priorities and adjust quickly

  • Clear, direct communication that builds trusted relationships across teams, and the ability to explain financial information simply to non-finance colleagues

  • An empathetic, approachable style, helping other teams get things right rather than just flagging what’s wrong

  • Resilience through month-end, audit, and shifting priorities, and the confidence to challenge constructively, including at senior level

  • Ownership of outcomes, sound judgement on when to act and when to escalate, and a drive to keep finding better ways of working

  • Direct-to-consumer experience is helpful but not essential

     

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Working Abroad - Flagstone employees can work remotely from an approved list of locations for up to 90 days a year

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.

     

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

title: Senior SAP Integration Consultant (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind itesys, DEIN synonym für Engineering Excellence. Wir sind über 200 Technikexpert:innen mit einer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für SAP-Technologie, SAP Security und Platform Engineering – und das seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2012. Wir sehen uns als kreative Köpfe und strategische Wegbereiter:innen, als Umsetzer:innen und Optimierer:innen, immer mit einer gehörigen Portion Spirit und Begeisterung. Genau diese Mischung macht uns aus! Wir kennen die digitalen Herausforderungen unserer Kundschaft und liefern die passenden Lösungen. Dank unseres tiefen Fachwissens und unserem ausgeprägten technischem Weitblick gelingt es uns, die IT-Landschaften unserer Kunden kontinuierlich an die komplexen und sich ständig verändernden Anforderungen anzupassen. Mit deinem Wissen… konzeptionieren, implementieren, realisieren und betreiben wir komplexe System- und berätst du unsere Kunden umfassend und weitsichtig mit einem hohen Servicegedanken betreust du eigenständig bestehende SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Landschaften und entwickelst diese mit internen und externen Schnittstellen weiter planst, organisierst und setzt du technische Projekte im SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Umfeld um leitest du die Implementierung und den Rollout von Schnittstellen in Kundensystemen, einschliesslich der Migration von SAP PI/PO auf die SAP Integration Suite führst du Performance Analysen durch und berätst unsere Kunden bei Architekturfragen und deren technischer Formulierung, auch im Hinblick auf die strategische Weiterentwicklung Richtung SAP Integration Suite Das gelingt dir durch... Berufserfahrung im SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Umfeld und mehrere erfolgreich realisierte Projekte in diesen Bereichen sehr gute Kenntnis von mindestens drei relevanten SAP Produkten (Logistik, HCM, ERP, S/4 oder vergleichbares) fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich SAP Software Architektur sowie Erfahrungen mit Integrationstechnologien wie z.B. Webservices/XML/SOAP/REST/OData eine strukturierte und zielführende Arbeitsweise, Eigenverantwortung und Begeisterung für herausfordernde Tätigkeiten Bereitschaft für Vor-Ort Termine bei Kunden sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Benefits Kostenloser Kaffee und Firmenparkplätze - kennst du vermutlich schon, oder? Wir möchten dir da schon etwas mehr bieten: Flexibles Jahresarbeitszeitmodell : Bye, 9-to-5! Deine Arbeitszeit kannst du dir bei uns frei einteilen. Weiterbildung : Bleibe immer up to date – mit bis zu zwei Wochen bezahlter Weiterbildung kein Problem Zukunftsorientierung : Als globale Tech-Company leben wir am Puls der Zeit und blicken stets in die Zukunft. Tools : Digitale Werkzeuge – die Essentials deiner Karriere. Bei uns kannst du Laptop und Smartphone aber auch privat nutzen. Teamspirit : Teambuildings oder Grillabende – wir finden immer einen Grund zusammenzukommen. Come as you are! : Bei uns geht es um das, was du draufhast – nicht um das, was du anhast. Lieber Casual, Business oder etwas dazwischen - come as you are! Mehr Ferientage : Die gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Ferientage sind dir nicht genug? Uns auch nicht, denn mit leeren Batterien arbeitet es sich nicht sehr gut! Workation & Entsendungen : Eigentlich am Schreibtisch aber mental schon wieder an deinem Lieblingsurlaubsort? Durch Workations und Entsendungen hat das Träumen ein Ende. Work-Life-Balance : Schon viel davon gehört aber nie erlebt? Bei uns bestimmst du deine Balance. Wellbeing : Es ist völlig okay, wenn nicht immer alles okay ist. Ob Stress, schlechter Schlaf oder schwierige Entscheidungen – unsere externe Online-Plattform bietet dir kostenlose, vertrauliche und anonyme Unterstützung durch erfahrene Expertinnen und Experten. Was macht es besonders, für uns zu arbeiten? Bei uns gleicht kein Tag dem anderen – Langeweile gibt es nicht. Du und deine Kolleg*innen werdet mit Blick auf eure Stärken individuell gefördert. Wir legen Wert auf Weiterbildungen und fördern den teamübergreifenden Wissenstransfer durch unsere Expertenteams. Zudem sind nahbare Führungskräfte und gezieltes Performance Management wichtige Bestandteile unserer Kultur. Teamwork makes the dream work – ist ja klar, oder? Jedes Teammitglied erfüllt eine wichtige Aufgabe, ohne die im Ganzen etwas fehlen würde. Wir sind uns sicher, dass diese Wertschätzung motiviert. Nicht ohne Grund sind wir alle mit Freude und Leidenschaft bei der Sache und erreichen dadurch Spitzenleistungen. Individualität macht uns aus: Teamwork ist uns wichtig, trotzdem verschwindet hier niemand in der Masse. Arbeiten mit Wohlfühl-Faktor Den itesys-Spirit haben wir ja schon erwähnt. Teamausflüge, gemeinsame Grillabende oder Office Brunch – wir finden immer einen Anlass zusammenzukommen. Bei uns muss niemand zum Lachen in den Keller gehen: in den Pausen herrscht eine lockere ausgelassene Atmosphäre bei dem alle willkommen sind. Beim Arbeiten kannst du jederzeit auf die Hilfsbereitschaft deiner Kolleg*innen zählen und musst dich nicht davor scheuen, Fragen zu stellen. Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen! Seit 2012 stehen wir als Schweizer Dienstleister für verlässliche SAP-Landschaften und fundierte Betriebserfahrung. In dieser Rolle verantworten Sie den Betrieb, den Unterhalt und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Rechenzentren, Netzwerke und Firewall-Infrastrukturen. Sie analysieren komplexe Netzwerkstrukturen, optimieren die Performance unserer Systeme und sorgen für eine reibungslose und sichere Datenkommunikation im hybriden Arbeitsumfeld an unserem Standort in Frauenfeld.   • Berufserfahrung im SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Umfeld und mehrere erfolgreich realisierte Projekte in diesen Bereichen

  • sehr gute Kenntnis von mindestens drei relevanten SAP Produkten (Logistik, HCM, ERP, S/4 oder vergleichbares)

  • eine strukturierte und zielführende Arbeitsweise, Eigenverantwortung und Begeisterung für herausfordernde Tätigkeiten

  • Bereitschaft für Vor-Ort Termine bei Kunden

  • sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Kostenloser Kaffee und Firmenparkplätze - kennst du vermutlich schon, oder?

Wir möchten dir da schon etwas mehr bieten:

Flexibles Jahresarbeitszeitmodell: Bye, 9-to-5! Deine Arbeitszeit kannst du dir bei uns frei einteilen.

Weiterbildung: Bleibe immer up to date – mit bis zu zwei Wochen bezahlter Weiterbildung kein Problem

Zukunftsorientierung: Als globale Tech-Company leben wir am Puls der Zeit und blicken stets in die Zukunft.

Tools: Digitale Werkzeuge – die Essentials deiner Karriere. Bei uns kannst du Laptop und Smartphone aber auch privat nutzen.

Teamspirit: Teambuildings oder Grillabende – wir finden immer einen Grund zusammenzukommen.

Bei uns gleicht kein Tag dem anderen – Langeweile gibt es nicht.

Du und deine Kolleg*innen werdet mit Blick auf eure Stärken individuell gefördert. Wir legen Wert auf Weiterbildungen und fördern den teamübergreifenden Wissenstransfer durch unsere Expertenteams. Sie analysieren komplexe Netzwerkstrukturen, optimieren die Performance unserer Systeme und sorgen für eine reibungslose und sichere Datenkommunikation im hybriden Arbeitsumfeld an unserem Standort in Frauenfeld.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal



This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead



Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority.

We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:

"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer."

If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.

Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.

And be prepared to change your own mind too.

The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.

Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.

You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.

But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded.

The Technical Challenge



Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.

At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.

Our backend estate includes:


  • .NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.
  • TypeScript services.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Cloudflare platform services.
  • API-first architecture.
  • Git-based development workflows.


We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.

We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.

We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.

What You'll Do



You'll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to:


  • Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.
  • Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.
  • Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.
  • Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.
  • Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.
  • Champion security, quality, testing, observability, resilience and performance.
  • Identify technical risks and help teams navigate them.
  • Evaluate technologies and patterns based on their value to SchemeServe rather than their popularity elsewhere.
  • Balance long-term engineering quality with short-term business needs.
  • Occasionally contribute directly to implementation when that's genuinely the best way to help.
  • Be a generally awesome person.


What We're Looking For



You'll need:


  • Deep expertise in modern backend engineering and strong commercial C#/.NET experience.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems and API design.
  • Experience with mature legacy applications and modern service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong cloud architecture experience, ideally Azure.
  • Excellent understanding of databases, security, testing, maintainability and modern software delivery.
  • Experience shaping engineering principles and practices across teams.
  • A track record of making engineers around you better through mentoring, coaching and technical leadership.
  • The ability to challenge experienced engineers constructively without becoming a gatekeeper.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held – the confidence to challenge and the humility to change your mind.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to influence without relying on authority.
  • Excellent technical judgement, balancing quality, complexity, risk, cost and business value.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who asks:

"What's the right solution for us?"

rather than:

"What's the way everyone else is doing it?"

Nice To Have


  • Experience modernising large monolithic applications.
  • Commercial TypeScript backend experience.
  • Cloudflare or edge technology experience.
  • SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Financial services, insurance or another regulated industry.
  • Observability, platform engineering or SRE experience.
  • AI-assisted development and engineering productivity tooling.


You don't need to tick every box.

If you've got the technical depth, judgement and ability to make engineers around you better, we'd rather have a conversation than lose a great candidate because you haven't used one particular technology.

What Success Looks Like



Within your first year:


  • Engineers are making stronger technical and architectural decisions with greater confidence.
  • Our engineering principles are understood rather than blindly followed.
  • Technical discussions are constructive, pragmatic and result in clear decisions.
  • Security, reliability, maintainability and performance concerns are identified earlier.
  • We've made sensible progress modernising our platform without adding complexity for complexity's sake.
  • You've made a lasting positive impact on both our software and the people who build it.


Ultimately, we don't want SchemeServe to become dependent on you for every difficult technical decision.

We want SchemeServe to become better at making those decisions because you're here.

Why Join SchemeServe?


  • Fully remote UK-based role.
  • Twice-yearly company retreats.
  • Flexible working.
  • Dedicated professional development support.
  • Paid charity days.

description: Du kennst dich mit Klaviyo aus, hast bereits E-Commerce-Marken betreut und möchtest weitere eigene Kunden und ein Team verantworten? Dann könnte das hier gut passen. Wir sind eine Agentur für E-Mail- und SMS-Marketing. Wir unterstützen DTC-Marken mit sieben- und achtstelligen Umsätzen dabei, mehr aus ihrem E-Mail-Marketing herauszuholen und langfristig zu wachsen. Bei uns übernimmst du die Betreuung mehrerer Kunden. Du entwickelst die Strategie, planst Kampagnen und koordinierst die Umsetzung mit deinem Team aus Copywriter, Designer und Klaviyo-Technician. Dabei behältst du die Ergebnisse im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden jederzeit wissen, woran wir arbeiten. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, klar kommuniziert und seine Aufgaben selbstständig voranbringt. WICHTIG: Erfahrung bei einer Agentur oder Brand ist Pflicht. Bitte bewerbe dich ansonsten nicht. Deine Aufgaben Kunden betreuen: Du bist der erste Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden, hältst sie auf dem Laufenden und kümmerst dich um Feedback und Freigaben. Strategien entwickeln: Du planst Kampagnen, Flows und Pop-ups, die zur jeweiligen Marke und ihren Zielen passen. Kampagnen planen: Du erstellst die monatlichen Kampagnenkalender und bringst eigene Ideen für Themen, Angebote und Tests ein. Dein Team koordinieren: Du briefst Copywriter, Designer und Klaviyo-Techniker und sorgst dafür, dass jeder weiß, was zu tun ist. Qualität prüfen: Du kontrollierst Texte, Designs und die technische Umsetzung. Du achtest darauf, dass jede E-Mail zur Marke passt und vor dem Versand sorgfältig geprüft wird.   • Process monitoring: Monitor operating parameters such as temperature, pressure, screw speed, feed rate, and material flow.

  • Workshop activities: Support the construction of prototypes, installation of sensors, and modification of experimental equipment.

  • Documentation: Record operating parameters, maintenance activities, and experimental observations.

  • Safety and organization: Maintain a safe, clean, and well-organized technical workspace.

  • Professional background as an extrusion technician, process technician, chemical engineer, or a comparable qualification
