title: Senior Commercial Manager
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is the world's fastest-growing defence technology company, bringing commercial technology talent and venture funding to the defence and security sectors. Our technology helps Australia, the United States, and allied nations solve their hardest national security challenges by enabling operators to make better, more informed decisions in life-and-death situations. We have assembled a diverse team of experts in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor fusion, optics, and data analysis that are creating software and hardware solutions to radically evolve the capabilities of Australia, the United States, our allies, and commercial customers. If you are passionate about solving problems that have a real impact, come join Anduril and build the future of defence.

A critical part of the Anduril team is its Contracts / Commercial Managers, who play a crucial role in program success. They interface daily with a motivated team of program leadership, functional leadership, and customers in fast-paced environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a talented Contracts / Commercial Manager to support a variety of Government, International, and Commercial contracts and programs. In this role, you will oversee the full contract lifecycle for Anduril's government and commercial contracts, ensuring compliance, minimizing risk, and optimizing contract performance. The ideal candidate will combine deep knowledge of commercial and defence contracting with strong negotiation skills and a passion for supporting national security through technological innovation.

The position will be responsible for providing contract support for various Government contracts and commercial contracts. Support of these contracts will involve proposal support, contract negotiation, contract compliance, contract management, contract modifications, and contract close-out. This role works closely with the legal and proposal teams as well as across the spectrum of Anduril’s accounting, business operations, program, and engineering teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Execute contract management throughout the life of each contract.
  • Complete contract review and acceptance.
  • Oversee and prepare contract proposal planning and management and support preparation of proposals.
  • Ensure compliance with government regulations, legal requirements, and company policies.
  • Assist in identification, development, and implementation of new contract policies and processes.
  • Maintain comprehensive contract documentation and compliance records.
  • Provide contract summaries and ensure contract execution in accordance with government and company requirements.
  • Provide program managers and executives with contract briefs during the life of contracts.
  • Provide guidance on ASDEFCON requirements and other regulatory considerations.
  • Cultivate strong, ongoing relationships with internal/external customers.
  • Provide contractual guidance and risk mitigation strategies for contractual and business obligations.
  • Negotiate complex contractual terms with government agencies, prime contractors, and subcontractors.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of relevant contract management experience.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, government, or a related field.
  • A strong working knowledge of Australian Government contracting including ASDEFCON, Commonwealth Procurement Rules (CPRs), and/or Defence Security Principles Framework (DSPF) experience.
  • Experience with full life cycle contract management for various types of contract agreements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. You are highly respected amongst your peers and/or counterparts and known as someone who gets things done.
  • Australian citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 security clearance.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience working for or with major Australian defence primes
  • IACCM/World Commerce & Contracting certification, Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or similar professional credentials
  • Graduate degree in business, law, government, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of AUKUS initiatives and Australia-US-UK defence collaboration framework

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. raw.description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

The role

You will report directly to the CTO and work alongside engineering, product, legal engineering and AI from the start. Your direct team is small today, three designers, and you will shape how it grows from here.

Your starting point is not a design backlog handed to you in advance. It is the product strategy, growth ambition, and AI-first operating model, and you will use that context to set the design agenda.

Orbital is at an inflection point. The product is live and trusted by some of the most demanding real estate legal professionals in the world. The challenge now is not building something from scratch but making it significantly better: cleaner, faster, and genuinely easier to trust. As the product scales across the UK and US, the design function needs to grow with it, and you will be the person who builds it.

What you'll do

Lead from the product.

Your first team is the product engineering leadership team. You will be part of product, commercial, and strategic conversations, bringing a strategic design perspective to business challenges rather than representing the design function in isolation. From there, you will form your own view on where the product experience is constraining growth, where the interface is creating friction for users, and what needs to change. You will help the leadership team pressure-test product decisions against user reality, spot where information architecture, interaction patterns, or visual clarity are becoming bottlenecks, and ensure that how we design is aligned with where the business is heading.

Set the design agenda from product context.

You will not be given a predefined project list. You will assess what you learn from the product, the users, and the business and set the design priorities from there. That means making sure areas like information architecture, interaction design, design systems, user research, and AI interface patterns are pointed at the right problems and prioritised accordingly. A major part of the brief is translating current product realities into a sharper design mandate and challenging existing assumptions when the evidence demands it.

Define what AI-native design looks like here.

The hardest design problems at Orbital are not aesthetic. They are epistemic. How do you help a real estate lawyer trust an AI output enough to put their name to it? How do you present the reasoning behind a 50-document analysis in a way that a partner can review in 20 minutes? How do you make agentic behaviour feel controllable to a professional who is accountable for the outcome? You will set the standard for how Orbital answers those questions, shape the interaction patterns that distinguish our product from everything else in the market, and hold the wider team accountable for the quality of the experience we ship.

Build the design function.

You will be the consistent presence the design team anchors around. You will invest in their growth, develop clear ownership within the function, and be accountable for the team's development over time, not just its immediate output. Over time you will shape a high-leverage design function that combines strong craft, deep user understanding, and a genuine instinct for where AI changes the rules.

Requirements

The must-haves

  • Significant experience leading product design at a senior level at a scaling B2B tech company. You bring real depth across the design discipline. That foundation is essential, but what sets you apart is the ability to operate beyond it.

  • A track record of sitting at the product leadership table and influencing business decisions, not just delivering a design agenda within one.

  • Experience scaling a design function through a high-growth phase, with the judgment to know what process and structure matters at each stage and what slows you down.

  • You have designed AI-native products. Not tools with AI bolted on. You have worked through the real problems: explainability, trust, agentic UX, confidence signals. You have opinions formed from real experience.

  • You have designed for expert professional users, people who know their domain better than any designer ever will, and you understand how to design for that dynamic without condescending or oversimplifying.

  • Strong commercial instincts. You understand how product design affects adoption, retention, and revenue, and you can connect design decisions to business outcomes.

  • The ability to translate product context into a design strategy and challenge existing priorities when the evidence demands it.

  • Experience leading through a design team, setting direction and standards without owning every deliverable.

And a few nice-to-haves

  • Direct experience of a Series B to Series C growth journey.

  • Built a design function from an early-stage base rather than inherited one.

  • Familiarity with legal tech, fintech, compliance tech or another domain where precision and professional accountability shape every design decision.

  • Experience building or significantly evolving a design system that improved team velocity at scale.

Why you'll love it here

  • You will join a company at a genuine inflection point, with real influence at the product engineering leadership table from day one.

  • You will shape the design function rather than inherit one, with room to build it around craft, research, and AI-first thinking.

  • The design problems here are some of the most interesting and challenging in the market.

  • You will be part of a collaborative, highly ambitious team where the standard is high and the ownership is real.

Benefits 🌟

🧑 💻 We believe in flexibility, but we're also big on in-person collaboration. This role is based in our London office with an expectation of multiple days in the office per week. It's about being present when it matters, and balancing autonomy with commitment.

🏢 Equity options in a fast-growing startup

🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

📚 Personal development budget and learning opportunities

🍔 Free lunch on Wednesdays and Deliveroo budget for late nights

🚲 Cycle-to-work scheme

📚 A bias toward experimentation, rapid learning, and iterating quickly based on real feedback

We're in the process of building an inclusive, welcoming culture where everyone feels seen and valued. Expect regular team off-sites, shared lunches, and social events, with something for everyone.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. The Role We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer . Data sits at the core of what tem does. Our time-series data is the spine that runs from pricing through to billing: every transaction depends on it working. You'll be working across a genuinely varied set of workloads: textual data, time-series data, and event streams, each with its own ingestion and reliability challenges, including TSDS. You'll join our Data Service team of 4, owning the design, reliability, and recovery strategy of specific ingestion pipelines and systems end-to-end. This is an individual contributor role: no team to manage, full ownership of the work you do. The team has more work than hands right now, and this role exists to close that gap so the business can move faster on the data it depends on. You'll also work closely with our AI initiatives as they grow: the platform you own increasingly becomes the foundation those efforts depend on. You will: Own the design, reliability, and recovery strategy for the ingestion pipelines and systems in your domain. Maintain and improve the data platform, including working through the existing tech debt backlog. Build monitoring and alerting so issues surface before they become incidents. Set the data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them. Help take the number of data products with a defined SLA from 2 to 10. Responsibilities Data Ingestion Own the design, reliability, and resilience of ingestion pipelines end-to-end, including TSDS, with a clear recovery strategy when things break. Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for new and existing data sources. Decide the right approach (batch vs. streaming) for each pipeline in your domain, including high-scale, low-latency requirements for time-series data. Set data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them. Platform Maintenance Own the day-to-day reliability of the data platform: monitoring, testing, and fixing issues before they become firefights. Own code quality and standards for the systems you're responsible for, including CI checks (linting, tests, coverage). Work through the existing tech debt backlog, prioritising fixes that unblock SLA commitments. Optimise pipelines for performance and cost as data volumes grow. Handle the failure modes specific to energy data: late arrivals, reprocessing, backfills. Monitoring & Alerting Build and improve observability across your systems so problems surface before they cause downstream impact. Set up alerting tied to the SLAs the team is committing to. Investigate and resolve issues within your domain, escalating genuinely cross-system problems. Supporting Expansion Help scope and prepare the platform for new data sources tied to international expansion. Flag where current architecture won't hold up as scope grows, even if fixing it isn't your call to make alone. Work closely with the AI team as their data needs on the platform grow. Requirements Must haves Strong Python skills, with proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. Experience owning the design, reliability, and resilience of a data pipeline or system end-to-end, not just writing pipeline code. AWS or GCP experience. Great communication skills, comfortable working directly with stakeholders to scope and agree SLAs, and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences. Strong team player, comfortable working independently against a backlog and making judgement calls on prioritisation, while fitting into an existing team of 4. Terraform experience. Bonus points Experience with time-series data at scale. Experience with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse). Experience in energy or climate tech. Background in high-growth startups or scale-ups. Genuine interest in how AI tooling and workflows intersect with data engineering. We're open to someone who doesn't tick every box here, as long as they bring solid AWS or GCP experience and the ability to own their own work end-to-end. Benefits & Perks Salary aligned to internal benchmarks and reviewed twice a year. Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Home working and wellbeing budgets: Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing. Interview Process We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know. Intro call with Talent, 30 minutes. Behavioural interview, 60 minutes. Skills interview with cross-functional leaders, 60 to 90 minutes, including a practical exercise. Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders, 45 minutes. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.   • Writing automations and scripts (Python or JavaScript, webhooks, Zapier/Make/n8n or direct API work) so leads, activities and revenue events land in the right place without anyone re-keying them

  • Documenting how the stack fits together and training the team on the parts they touch

  • Proven experience building outreach or prospect lists with scraping and enrichment tools such as Clay

  • Solid SQL and comfort in a BI tool such as Metabase

  • Practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling in real workflows, with a clear view of where they help and where they don't

  • A high bar for data quality and the discipline to keep systems tidy over time

  • Clear written communication, translating what sales and marketing need into systems that deliver it

Alongside your CV, include a short note about one data or automation problem you've solved for a sales team and how you did it. Links to anything you've built (repos, Clay tables, dashboards, write-ups) are welcome.

We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

Please note this is a hybrid role with 3 days a week in our Paris office.

About The Role

We're looking for a Territory Account Executive to join our expanding Mid Market team in Paris.

There are a few things we take really seriously here at monday.com: building an amazing product and providing the best possible service to our customers. Our clients love our product, and it's incredibly unique (and fun) to walk our clients to success using our platform.

  • The Territory Account Executive (Mid Market) position owns the full sales cycle from territory mapping, outbound pipeline generation, building relationships with key stakeholders, negotiation & contracting, to closing the deal

  • Work closely with current and prospective customers in the region as a trusted digital advisor to gain a deep understanding of their outstanding company challenges and goals.

  • Possess a comprehensive understanding of monday.com’s solution and connect this knowledge directly to customer ROI

  • Identify and drive expansion opportunities through business development and strategic market mapping, working to meet and exceed quotas.

  • Develop strategies and coordinate cross-functional support to help customers maximize the value from the monday.com solution

  • Empower our customers to connect their goals and challenges with the solution on monday.com.

  • Partner with the customer going forward to help them grow with monday.com

Requirements

  • 3 -5 years of sales experience in a closing role at a SaaS company

  • Experience in strategic digital transformation

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills

  • Track record of success and overachievement

  • Experience navigating complex deals with multiple stakeholders, while maintaining a strong consultative selling approach

  • Driven self-starter with a growth mindset and solution oriented approach

  • Collaborative, high-energy teammate

  • Able to effectively and consistently manage time, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines

  • Native level fluency in French

  • BA/BS degree preferred; or equivalent relevant work experience

What monday.com can offer you:

  • Join a customer-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate - not just things we put on a wall

  • Work on a multi-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide

  • Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success

  • Grow fast through a dedicated L&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons - the industry moves quick and so do we

  • A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more

Über New Monday Wir sind New Monday und begleiten Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte – von der ersten Idee über die Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zu Design und technischer Umsetzung. Dafür bringen wir Kompetenzen aus Business Analyse, UX/UI Design und Softwareentwicklung zusammen. Als Teil von New Monday bringst du deine Expertise direkt in die Projekte unserer Kunden ein. Dort arbeitest du in der Regel als Mitglied des Kundenteams eng mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichen, Product Ownern und Entwicklungsteams zusammen. Du machst komplexe Anforderungen verständlich, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und gestaltest Lösungen, die Nutzer und Unternehmen weiterhelfen. Dein berufliches Zuhause bleibt New Monday: Wir begleiten dich während deines Projekteinsatzes, unterstützen deine Weiterentwicklung und schaffen Raum für fachlichen Austausch und persönliche Begegnungen im Team. Deine Aufgaben Du analysierst und strukturierst prozessuale Anforderungen und entwickelst fachliche sowie technische Umsetzungskonzepte. Du übersetzt fachliche Bedarfe in klare, umsetzungsreife Spezifikationen als Grundlage für die technische Realisierung. Du arbeitest dich in komplexe Systemlandschaften und ihre Prozesse ein, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und dokumentierst konkrete Handlungsbedarfe. Du bearbeitest definierte Testpakete, führst Reviews durch und analysierst auftretende Fehler. Dabei dokumentierst und bewertest du Fehlerbilder aus fachlicher Sicht. Du erarbeitest Lösungsoptionen und Handlungsempfehlungen und stimmst diese mit angrenzenden Rollen und Fachbereichen ab. Du behältst den gesamten Prozess über die drei Anwendungen hinweg im Blick und hilfst dabei, den Nutzen der Lösung kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung in der Business Analyse oder im Requirements Engineering für komplexe IT-Projekte. Die Fähigkeit, fachliche und prozessuale Anforderungen systematisch aufzunehmen, zu hinterfragen und verständlich zu dokumentieren. Technisches Verständnis, um Zusammenhänge, Abhängigkeiten und Schnittstellen innerhalb einer Systemlandschaft zu analysieren. Erfahrung mit der Erstellung von Spezifikationen und Umsetzungskonzepten sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams. Erfahrung mit fachlichen Tests, Reviews und der Analyse und Bewertung von Fehlern. Eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Teamtreffen in Essen. Das erwartet dich bei New Monday Flexibles Arbeiten passend zum Projekt: In diesem Projekt arbeitest du überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Gelegentliche Teamtreffen finden vor Ort in Essen statt. Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du organisierst deine Arbeit eigenständig und stimmst dich dabei mit deinem Kundenteam ab. Bei New Monday setzen wir auf kurze Abstimmungswege und Vertrauen. Aufgaben mit Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung direkt im Kundenprojekt ein und gestaltest digitale Prozesse mit, die den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen unterstützen. Persönliche Begleitung im Projekteinsatz: Auch wenn dein Arbeitsalltag überwiegend im Kundenteam stattfindet, bleiben wir mit dir im Austausch und begleiten dich bei Fragen, Herausforderungen und deiner Entwicklung. Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte New-Monday-Team zusammen. Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung. Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir regelmäßig mit dir. 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events. So geht es weiter Erstes Kennenlernen: Wir erzählen dir mehr über New Monday, die Rolle und das Kundenprojekt. Du berichtest uns von deiner Erfahrung und kannst alle Fragen stellen, die dir wichtig sind. Vertiefender Austausch: Wir sprechen ausführlicher über deine bisherigen Projekte, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Erfahrung in der Business Analyse und im Requirements Engineering. Kennenlernen im Kundenprojekt: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, stellen wir dich beim Kunden vor. Dort lernst du das Projektumfeld und die beteiligten Ansprechpartner kennen. Die weiteren Schritte stimmen wir transparent mit dir ab. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung vollständig erfüllst! New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt. Dein Einstieg Die Stelle ist auf 12 Monate befristet, umfasst 40 Stunden pro Woche und sieht eine Probezeit von 6 Monaten vor. Wenn du dich in den Anforderungen wiederfindest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über die Plattform. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Als IT-Projektmanager (m/w/d) begleitest du Softwareentwicklungsprojekte von der Initialisierung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Entwicklungsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst für Transparenz bei Zielen, Anforderungen, Terminen und Projektfortschritt.

Dabei bringst du mehrjährige Erfahrung im IT-Projektumfeld mit, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei unterschiedlichen Anforderungen den Überblick.

Aufgaben

  • Du planst und steuerst Softwareentwicklungsprojekte hinsichtlich Qualität, Budget und Terminen.
  • Du koordinierst Projektteams sowie interne und externe Stakeholder und sorgst für eine verbindliche Zusammenarbeit.
  • Du unterstützt den Übergang vom Vertrieb in die Projektumsetzung und begleitest eine strukturierte Projektinitialisierung.
  • Du strukturierst Anforderungen, unterstützt beim Scope Management und sorgst für Transparenz bei Veränderungen.
  • Du behältst Projektaufwände, Zeitpläne und Abhängigkeiten im Blick und erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig.
  • Du identifizierst Risiken und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten geeignete Maßnahmen.
  • Du begleitest Projekte bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und trägst zu einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit bei.
  • Du bereitest Projektstatusgespräche, Workshops und Kundenmeetings vor und moderierst diese strukturiert.

Qualifikation

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Leitung, Steuerung oder Koordination von IT- oder Softwareentwicklungsprojekten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und interdisziplinären Projektteams.
  • Du kennst agile Vorgehensweisen wie Scrum oder Kanban und setzt diese sicher im Projektalltag ein.
  • Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Projektplanung, Anforderungs- und Scope-Management sowie wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Projektbudgets, Zeitplänen, Aufwänden und Risiken.
  • Du verfügst über ein technisches Grundverständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Jira, Azure DevOps oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.
  • Du interessierst dich für aktuelle Entwicklungen im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz und nutzt moderne KI-gestützte Werkzeuge, um Projekte effizienter und erfolgreicher zu steuern.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

Womit du zusätzlich punktest

  • Du hast Erfahrung in Softwareentwicklungs-, Digitalisierungs- oder KI-nahen Projekten.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt oder im Umfeld einer IT-Beratung mit.
  • Du verfügst über Zertifizierungen wie Scrum Master, PRINCE2 oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen.
  • Du hast Grundkenntnisse in Cloud-, DevOps- oder Architekturthemen.
  • Du verfolgst aktuelle Technologietrends und hast Interesse daran, neue Methoden und KI-gestützte Ansätze in die Projektarbeit einzubringen.

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit, an bis zu zwei Tagen pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten
  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten inkl. Übernahme von Weiterbildungskosten
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Individuelle Entfaltung und ein respektvolles Miteinander
  • Offene Unternehmenskultur, angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre & regelmäßige Teamevents
  • Langfristige Perspektiven, betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Krankenzusatzversicherung (BKzV)
  • Mehr Work-Life-Balance durch eine Kooperation mit unserem Partner voiio
  • Wahlweise Zuschuss zu Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft oder BVG-Ticket
  • Inanspruchnahme von Rabatten über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits

title: Senior Projektleiter (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle bei uns Du übernimmst die übergreifende Steuerung großer Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallelen IT- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten. Dabei verantwortest du Termine, Budgets, Ressourcen, Qualität und Risiken und führst Projektmanager und Projektteams fachlich. Dein Fokus liegt auf einer belastbaren, projektübergreifenden Steuerung. Du erkennst Risiken und Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig und greifst gezielt ein, wenn Projekte aus der Spur geraten. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Delivery Management sorgst du dafür, dass komplexe Kundenaccounts erfolgreich gesteuert werden. Aufgaben Du steuerst große Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallelen IT- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten und behältst Termine, Budgets, Qualität und Risiken im Gesamtblick. Du steuerst und unterstützt die Projektteams innerhalb deines Accounts und förderst deren fachliche Weiterentwicklung im Rahmen der laufenden Projekte. Du setzt ein wirksames Risikomanagement um und stellst sicher, dass Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Eskalationen frühzeitig erkannt, bewertet und adressiert werden. Du begleitest die Übergabe neuer Projekte aus dem Vertrieb in die Delivery und schärfst Scope, Erwartungen und Kalkulation. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Delivery Excellence Projektmanagement-Standards, Methoden und Best Practices weiter. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Projektcontrolling sowie in der Budget- und Forecaststeuerung, im Risiko- und Eskalationsmanagement mit. Du bist erfahren in der Steuerung anspruchsvoller Kunden und im Umgang mit Management- und Entscheidungsebenen. Du bist in der Lage, kritische Projektsituationen schnell zu erfassen, geeignete Maßnahmen einzuleiten und Projekte nachhaltig zu stabilisieren. Du verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungsprojekten, IT-Architekturen und modernen Entwicklungsprozessen. Du denkst unternehmerisch und verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge von IT-Projekten. Du trittst souverän auf und überzeugst durch Kommunikations- und Moderationsstärke sowie eine hohe Entscheidungssicherheit. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mindestens C1-Niveau. Womit du zusätzlich punktest Du bringst Erfahrung aus dem IT-Beratungs-, Softwareentwicklungs- oder IT-Dienstleistungsumfeld mit. Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Plane, Moco oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen. Du verfügst über Zertifizierungen wie IPMA, PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen. Du hast bereits kritische oder eskalierte IT-Projekte erfolgreich stabilisiert. description: Deine Rolle bei uns Als Systemadministrator IT-Infrastruktur (m/w/d) sorgst du für den stabilen, sicheren und zukunftsfähigen Betrieb unserer IT-Landschaft. Unsere Infrastruktur ist etabliert und gleichzeitig in stetiger Weiterentwicklung. Du bringst dich aktiv mit Ideen ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Cloud- und Infrastrukturthemen und unterstützt unsere Kolleg:innen als kompetente Ansprechperson im IT-Alltag. Aufgaben Du sorgst für den stabilen und sicheren Betrieb unserer cloudbasierten IT-Infrastruktur. Du administrierst und optimierst unsere Microsoft-365-Landschaft (Azure, Intune, Exchange und Teams). title: Social Creative (m/w/d)
description: Du lebst Social Media, denkst in Formaten und Hooks und hast ständig Ideen, aus denen Content werden will? Du weißt, was auf TikTok, Instagram und YouTube läuft, bevor es alle machen und kannst daraus Konzepte bauen, die für einige der coolsten Brands Deutschlands funktionieren? Dann sollten wir reden. Wir suchen keine klassische Social-Media-Manager:in, die Redaktionspläne verwaltet und auch keine reine Producer:in. Wir suchen einen kreativen Kopf: jemanden, der Social Content wirklich versteht und lebt und vor allem Content Pieces konzipieren kann. Die Produktion selbst übernehmen meistens unsere externen Dienstleister:innen, aber wenn du selbst zur Kamera greifen oder schneiden kannst, ist das ein dickes Plus. ACHTUNG: Wir wollen DICH kennenlernen und nicht nur deinen Lebenslauf. Zeig uns, wer du bist, am besten in einem Format, das dich repräsentiert. Deine besten Ideen, ein Konzept, ein Moodboard, ein Portfolio. Bewerbungen, die nur aus einem Lebenslauf bestehen, können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen. WICHTIG: Da wir unser Social-Media-Team in Hamburg aufbauen, ist uns der persönliche Austausch wichtig. Wir haben gerade unser Produktions-Office in Eimsbüttel eröffnet und treffen uns regelmäßig, um gemeinsam zu arbeiten und uns auszutauschen. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden direkt aus Hamburg, die/der Lust hat, mit uns Zeit im Office zu verbringen und einen starken Team-Kern zu formen. Aufgaben Deine Mission, falls du sie annimmst: Du entwickelst kreative Content-Konzepte, von der ersten Idee über das Storyboard bis zum fertigen Briefing für die Umsetzung. Du denkst in Formaten, Trends und Plattform-Logiken und übersetzt Brand-Ziele in Content, der scrollt-stoppt. Du bist „always on": Du kennst die Feeds, Sounds, Memes und Creator, bevor sie viral gehen und machst daraus Ideen für unsere Brands. Du steuerst die Umsetzung mit externen Dienstleister:innen und Creatorn: Du briefst klar, gibst kreatives Feedback und sorgst dafür, dass aus deinem Konzept am Ende richtig guter Content wird. Du arbeitest strategisch mit: Du verstehst, was eine Brand erreichen will, und baust Content, der auf Ziele einzahlt, nicht nur auf Likes. Du erkennst Trends früh und machst daraus schnelle, reaktive Formate (Real-Time-Content, wenn's drauf ankommt). Du analysierst, was funktioniert, lernst aus Daten und schärfst deine Konzepte so lange, bis sie performen. Du stimmst dich eng mit der Brand, weiteren Partner:innen und unserem Team ab und bringst deine kreative Handschrift ein. Qualifikation Was du mitbringst: Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Social-Media- oder Content-Umfeld, idealerweise für große Brands oder in Agenturen. Du verstehst und lebst Social Content, du weißt aus dem Bauch heraus, was auf welcher Plattform funktioniert und warum. Stärke in der Konzeption: Du kannst aus einer Brand-Aufgabe eigenständig Content-Ideen und Formate entwickeln und sie so briefen, dass andere sie umsetzen können. Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Plattformen und ihre Mechaniken. Meta, TikTok und YouTube sind dein Zuhause. Du lebst „always on": echter Draht zu Trends, Sounds, Creator-Culture und Internet-Humor. Strategisches Denken: Du weißt, dass Content nicht nur schön aussehen, sondern etwas erreichen soll. Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu jonglieren. Reiselust: Für unsere Produktionen sind wir viel unterwegs und wir erwarten von Dir, bei den Drehs am Start zu sein. Nice to have: Wenn du selbst produzieren kannst, Kamera, Schnitt (CapCut, Premiere o.ä.), umso besser. Wenn du weißt, wie man in der Influencer-Bubble navigiert, ebenfalls ein Plus! Benefits Ein Team von Expert:innen: Ein offenes, kleines Expert:innen-Team mit flachen Hierarchien, in dem jede:r mitreden und entscheiden darf. Wir leben eine Kultur, die Fehler erlaubt und das Lernen fördert. Flexible Arbeitskultur: Unsere Basis ist in Berlin (mit Clubhouse), unser Social Team in Hamburg Eimsbüttel, aber wir leben Flexibilität: Arbeiten im Ausland und Home-Office sind Standard. Deine Entwicklung: Wir bieten dir Zugang zu den größten Events und den besten Weiterbildungen, damit du dich stetig weiterentwickeln kannst. Coole Brands: Zusammenarbeit mit den coolsten Brands & Creatorn aus allen Bereichen. Top-Ausstattung & Benefits: Alles an Technik, was du für deine Arbeit brauchst, inklusive iPhone, MacBook und wenn du es brauchst auch Deutschlandticket, Bahncard und andere Mobilitätslösungen. Merchandise: Das beste Merchandise von allen! Zahlen, Daten, Fakten: Start: ASAP Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h Arbeitsstunden pro Woche) Erfahrungslevel: Berufserfahren (Midlevel, mind. 3 Jahre) Bist du bereit, deine Ideen in die Tat umzusetzen und den coolsten Job zu starten, den du jemals haben wirst? Dann zeig uns, was du drauf hast und bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir können es kaum erwarten, Dich kennenzulernen! XOXO – der Club. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Lead
raw.description:
About CyberCube:

CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.

  • AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.

  • Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

  • Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

  • Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

  • A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

  • A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.

  • People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Work in a team of cyber threat analysts, economists, data scientists, actuaries and risk modelers to develop insights, scores, and features for a suite of products delivering cyber risk analytics to the (re)insurance industry

  • Own CyberCube's point of view on technology risk including factors such as:

    • Offensive capabilities and trends among threat actor classes, and validating CyberCube models against observed real-world events,

    • Security hygiene standards (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS) and mitigations for companies to lower their potential likelihood and/or impact of events, and

    • Technology adoption and trends including the adoption, reliance on and governance of artificial intelligence

… translating these factors into the assumptions and scenarios that drive risk models – especially where historical data is limited

  • Own the scenario and "event family" library for cyber catastrophe modeling, including emerging AI-driven scenarios

  • Own the assumptions register and expert-judgment governance: the documented, client-defensible rationale for modeling choices that are not purely data-driven

  • Present CyberCube methodology, threat landscape and emerging risk trends to clients and prospects and engage in strategic dialogue with key stakeholders as one of CyberCube's key voices and thought leaders on technology risk. Be able to differentiate when speaking with varying technical backgrounds and seniority (e.g. analyst to C-Suite)

  • Engage in cross functional collaboration with stakeholders from engineering, product management, analytics personnel, and client facing teams to deliver on projects and product goals

  • Deliver various cyber threat intelligence reports – e.g. threat landscape, scenario libraries, changes to mitigation and exploitation assumptions, etc. – on a quarterly cadence

The Skills and Experience You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in cyber security, computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or related field

  • 3-5 years experience in offensive and/or defensive cyber security (CISSP, CEH, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or other certification preferred)

  • Working fluency in Python / R, SQL, flat files and complex data types (JSON, XML), APIs, and Excel – enough to specify and interpret analysis with Data/Analytics teams

  • Ability to translate real-world cyber threat behavior into modeling assumptions and scenarios – e.g. scenario likelihoods, severity, and mitigation impacts

  • Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new skills, and push ideas forward

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication and consulting presence with key stakeholders

  • Experience working in and leading project teams

  • Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced startup environment

  • Ability to maintain relationships, collaborate effectively, and meet deadlines with a distributed, remote-first workforce

  • Ability to think creatively and respond to emerging threats (cyber, AI, other) and their modeling implications in a timely manner

The Extra Credit, or The Focus Areas You Will Develop

  • Experience with analytics and risk modeling

  • Experience in a SaaS product development environment

  • Familiarity with ML techniques and statistical data analysis

  • Familiarity with AI / LLM risk and its implications for cyber risk, social engineering, product safety, errors/omissions, and critical infrastructure

  • Familiarity with a wide variety of Internet technologies such as BGP, TCP/IP, DNS, etc.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Play an instrumental role in reshaping one of the key industries in the world

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely

  • Opportunity to participate in a secondment program

  • Company-supported mentorship program

  • Grow in a collaborative, respectful, and empathetic culture

US specific

  • Competitive salary and unlimited PTO

  • Generous healthcare benefits with medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Monthly catered lunches and happy hours

  • Company-paid learning and development assistance

  • Dependant care assistance plan

UK specific

  • Competitive salary, pension and benefits

  • Generous private medical healthcare insurance with dental and vision coverage

  • Extra vacation days during winter holidays

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

We don’t tolerate discrimination against age, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, race, color, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, veteran status, protected genetic information or political affiliation.

title: Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce
description: Build, Scale & Operate Leading DTC Brands alongside A-Players Maneuver Marketing Our Vision, Mission & Success are fuelled by our commitment to be a driving force of positive change to the health of everyday consumers, providing conscious, high-quality & innovative supplement products. In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs. These results caught the attention of The Financial Times , as they ranked us among APACs top High-Growth Companies. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards , jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore. This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth! Your Next Role We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly organized Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce to lead and scale our creator marketing capability. You will own the end-to-end creator strategy and drive implementation for two women’s health brands. One brand offers supplements that help with symptoms and root causes, and the other offers supplements that support one’s lifestyle habits and addresses nutritional gaps. Leading a team of two associates who execute the seeding program, you will upgrade and refine our current strategy to build a reliable community of high-quality creator partnerships that strengthen our organic presence, generate commercially valuable content and support our paid media performance. This is a hands-on management role. You will set the strategy and performance targets, develop the team, improve our systems and processes, and remain directly involved in high-value partnerships and campaign decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong creator marketing instincts with operational discipline, commercial judgment and a clear understanding of how creator content can be transformed into effective paid advertising. What You’ll Do 1. Own the Creator Strategy Across Both Brands Own creator strategy for two women's health brands across two distinct motions: an established seeding program producing content at volume, and a new TikTok Shop affiliate program built for direct sales. Scope is deliberately asymmetric. Seeding covers 4 flagship SKUs today, expanding to all 6 once the team's agentic workflows free the capacity. TikTok Shop launches focused on 2 products under one brand. Build creator-driven demand that shows up beyond the platform it originates on: branded search volume, Amazon and Shopify sales lift, and a content library that feeds paid media. Identify the right mix of healthcare professionals and content creators for each campaign. Establish measurable targets across outreach volume, response rates, partnership approvals, content delivery, cost efficiency and campaign performance. Monitor competitor activity, creator pricing and emerging platform trends to keep our approach relevant and competitive. Build and deploy AI workflows that increase the team's throughput - creator qualification, outreach personalization at volume, content tagging and rights tracking. We expect measurable capacity gains, not experimentation. 2. Lead and Develop the Creator Marketing Team The Meta seeding program is built and running at scale. Your associates own the day-to-day operations; your job is to consult with creative leads, sharpen briefs, run creative tests, and hold quality while the majority of your own attention goes to TikTok and affiliates. Oversee the team’s day-to-day outreach, follow-ups, creator communication, fulfilment coordination and administrative workflows. Build clear processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to manage a high volume of influencer activity accurately and efficiently. 3. Build a Scalable Creator Acquisition Pipeline Source creators across three routes: direct outreach, the TikTok Shop affiliate marketplace, and the established creator network available through our TikTok consultant. Convert the consultant's network into signed, producing partnerships rather than a list. Sustain the current output of hundreds of pieces of creator content per month across the seeding program, while building a separate affiliate creator pipeline for TikTok Shop. Assess potential partners based on audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, pricing and their ability to create or follow relevant trends. Develop partnerships with a strong focus on micro- and mid-sized creators, while selectively pursuing larger influencers when commercially justified. Create tailored outreach strategies for a competitive market in which larger brands may offer significantly higher creator fees. 4. Build the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program Own the TikTok Shop affiliate program for 2 products under one brand, from creator recruitment through commission structure, sample logistics and GMV performance. Set and manage commission tiers, open collaborations, targeted invites and any performance-based arrangements; decide where flat-fee and where commission-only makes sense. Own affiliate GMV as a number you're accountable for, and the unit economics behind it: cost per acquired affiliate, sample cost per producing creator, blended commission rate. Identify and develop the small number of affiliates who will drive the majority of GMV, and build repeat and exclusive arrangements with them. Work with the TikTok Affiliate Creative Strategist on creative direction. They own research, concept and brief content; you own creator supply, terms, relationship and program performance. 5. Own Campaign Execution and Creator Relationships Oversee partnerships from initial outreach and qualification through contracting, product delivery, content production, payment and performance review. Ensure creators receive clear briefs, campaign expectations, timelines and feedback. Build strong, professional relationships that encourage creators to become long-term brand advocates rather than one-off partners. Maintain an active and engaged creator community through regular updates, challenges, educational content and brand communications. Own claims compliance in creator content across both brands. Maintain the do-say/don't-say guidance creators work from, and make sure it holds at volume across seeding, affiliate and organic. Ensure FTC material-connection disclosure and platform-specific policy compliance on every partnership. TikTok Shop enforces supplement claims differently from Meta; both need to be handled correctly. 6. Turn Creator Content into Growth Assets Secure usage rights and TikTok ad authorization (Spark Ad codes) at the point of partnership, not retroactively. Establish a clear process for reviewing, categorizing and distributing creator-generated content. Evaluate content based on brand alignment, creative quality, audience relevance and potential commercial use. Work with Paid Media, Creative and Marketplace to route creator content to its highest-value use: paid social, marketplace listings, email and brand channels. Translate both organic and paid media learnings back into creator briefs so creators can produce stronger, more testable content. Supply the brand social channels with a steady flow of approved, on-brand creator content. Publishing and community management on brand-owned accounts sit with a separate role. 7. Own Tools, Vendors and Operational Excellence Manage our external partners - the TikTok consultant and content agencies - including scope, output quality, cost and the decision on when capability should move in-house. Own the influencer marketing stack end to end. We currently run SARAL; assess whether it, Modash, Lefty or an alternative best serves discovery, outreach, relationship management and reporting at our volume. Partner with Supply and Operations teams to ensure product kits are shipped accurately and on time. Oversee creator invoicing and payment workflows, ensuring submissions are accurate, approved and processed promptly. Identify bottlenecks and introduce scalable workflows, automation and documentation where appropriate. 7. Measure and Improve Performance You'll be measured on four things: TikTok Shop affiliate GMV, cost per usable content asset, branded search and marketplace lift attributable to creator activity, and content throughput against quality standard. Everything else is diagnostic. You'll manage a defined creator and sampling budget across both programs, with authority to reallocate between seeding and affiliate based on returns. Define and monitor the KPIs required to evaluate the health and commercial impact of the influencer program. Track outreach volume, open and response rates, approval rates, creator acquisition costs, content delivery, engagement, reach, conversions and return on investment. Build clear weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting for the Growth team and company leadership. Analyze performance by creator profile, product, platform, partnership structure, outreach message and content format. Maintain a structured testing roadmap covering outreach messages, incentives, creator segments and content approaches. How You’ll Succeed You combine strategic thinking with a willingness to remain close to execution. You create clarity for your team, hold people accountable and help them improve. You build a predictable pipeline of relevant creators and commercially valuable content. You use data and experimentation to improve response rates, partnership quality and return on investment. You can recognize creators who offer strong value beyond follower count alone. You build effective partnerships across Creator Marketing, Paid Media, Creative, Supply, Email Marketing and E-commerce. You introduce structure without slowing down execution. You communicate clearly, act quickly and resolve problems before they affect campaigns. You remain resourceful in a competitive market where budgets and creator expectations may not always align. You care equally about relationship quality, operational accuracy and commercial outcomes. What You Bring Required 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or creator affiliate marketing, including at least one program you owned end to end with commercial accountability. Operator experience running a TikTok Shop or comparable creator affiliate program, with GMV or revenue you were personally accountable for. DTC or e-commerce experience in health and wellness, beauty, or another regulated consumer category. Experience managing or mentoring team members, with evidence you raised their output rather than just reviewed it. Experience managing external agencies, consultants or vendors: setting scope, holding quality, deciding when to bring work in-house. Experience structuring and negotiating both flat-fee and performance-based partnerships. Strong analytical skills and a track record of using campaign data to change decisions, not just report them. Evidence of an AI or automation workflow you built or deployed that measurably increased throughput. Be ready to walk through what it does and what it saved. Strongly preferred Ownership of brand-owned organic social channels, not only creator programs. You understand how owned content and creator content compound. Working knowledge of FTC material-connection disclosure and platform claim policy in a regulated category. You know what a creator cannot say about a supplement, and why the answer differs on TikTok and Meta. Experience collaborating with Paid Media or Creative to repurpose creator content into performance advertising, including securing ad authorization at partnership time. Hands-on with an influencer marketing platform - SARAL, Modash, Lefty or equivalent. Experience running influencer or creator programs across multiple brands or product categories. Experience partnering with healthcare professionals or subject-matter experts as brand partners. Understanding of paid social creative testing and direct-response fundamentals. Genuine interest in health, wellness, consumer behavior and social media culture. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Our Vision, Mission & Success are fuelled by our commitment to be a driving force of positive change to the health of everyday consumers, providing conscious, high-quality & innovative supplement products.

In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs.

These results caught the attention of The Financial Times, as they ranked us among APACs top High-Growth Companies. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards, jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore.

This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth!

Your Next Role

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly organized Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce to lead and scale our creator marketing capability.

You will own the end-to-end creator strategy and drive implementation for two women’s health brands. One brand offers supplements that help with symptoms and root causes, and the other offers supplements that support one’s lifestyle habits and addresses nutritional gaps.

Leading a team of two associates who execute the seeding program, you will upgrade and refine our current strategy to build a reliable community of high-quality creator partnerships that strengthen our organic presence, generate commercially valuable content and support our paid media performance.

This is a hands-on management role. You will set the strategy and performance targets, develop the team, improve our systems and processes, and remain directly involved in high-value partnerships and campaign decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong creator marketing instincts with operational discipline, commercial judgment and a clear understanding of how creator content can be transformed into effective paid advertising.

What You’ll Do

1. Own the Creator Strategy Across Both Brands

  • Own creator strategy for two women's health brands across two distinct motions: an established seeding program producing content at volume, and a new TikTok Shop affiliate program built for direct sales.

  • Scope is deliberately asymmetric. Seeding covers 4 flagship SKUs today, expanding to all 6 once the team's agentic workflows free the capacity. TikTok Shop launches focused on 2 products under one brand.

  • Build creator-driven demand that shows up beyond the platform it originates on: branded search volume, Amazon and Shopify sales lift, and a content library that feeds paid media.

  • Identify the right mix of healthcare professionals and content creators for each campaign.

  • Establish measurable targets across outreach volume, response rates, partnership approvals, content delivery, cost efficiency and campaign performance.

  • Monitor competitor activity, creator pricing and emerging platform trends to keep our approach relevant and competitive.

  • Build and deploy AI workflows that increase the team's throughput - creator qualification, outreach personalization at volume, content tagging and rights tracking. We expect measurable capacity gains, not experimentation.

2. Lead and Develop the Creator Marketing Team

  • The Meta seeding program is built and running at scale. Your associates own the day-to-day operations; your job is to consult with creative leads, sharpen briefs, run creative tests, and hold quality while the majority of your own attention goes to TikTok and affiliates.

  • Oversee the team’s day-to-day outreach, follow-ups, creator communication, fulfilment coordination and administrative workflows.

  • Build clear processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to manage a high volume of influencer activity accurately and efficiently.

3. Build a Scalable Creator Acquisition Pipeline

  • Source creators across three routes: direct outreach, the TikTok Shop affiliate marketplace, and the established creator network available through our TikTok consultant. Convert the consultant's network into signed, producing partnerships rather than a list.

  • Sustain the current output of hundreds of pieces of creator content per month across the seeding program, while building a separate affiliate creator pipeline for TikTok Shop.

  • Assess potential partners based on audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, pricing and their ability to create or follow relevant trends.

  • Develop partnerships with a strong focus on micro- and mid-sized creators, while selectively pursuing larger influencers when commercially justified.

  • Create tailored outreach strategies for a competitive market in which larger brands may offer significantly higher creator fees.

4. Build the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

  • Own the TikTok Shop affiliate program for 2 products under one brand, from creator recruitment through commission structure, sample logistics and GMV performance.

  • Set and manage commission tiers, open collaborations, targeted invites and any performance-based arrangements; decide where flat-fee and where commission-only makes sense.

  • Own affiliate GMV as a number you're accountable for, and the unit economics behind it: cost per acquired affiliate, sample cost per producing creator, blended commission rate.

  • Identify and develop the small number of affiliates who will drive the majority of GMV, and build repeat and exclusive arrangements with them.

  • Work with the TikTok Affiliate Creative Strategist on creative direction. They own research, concept and brief content; you own creator supply, terms, relationship and program performance.

5. Own Campaign Execution and Creator Relationships

  • Oversee partnerships from initial outreach and qualification through contracting, product delivery, content production, payment and performance review.

  • Ensure creators receive clear briefs, campaign expectations, timelines and feedback.

  • Build strong, professional relationships that encourage creators to become long-term brand advocates rather than one-off partners.

  • Maintain an active and engaged creator community through regular updates, challenges, educational content and brand communications.

  • Own claims compliance in creator content across both brands. Maintain the do-say/don't-say guidance creators work from, and make sure it holds at volume across seeding, affiliate and organic.

  • Ensure FTC material-connection disclosure and platform-specific policy compliance on every partnership. TikTok Shop enforces supplement claims differently from Meta; both need to be handled correctly.

6. Turn Creator Content into Growth Assets

  • Secure usage rights and TikTok ad authorization (Spark Ad codes) at the point of partnership, not retroactively.

  • Establish a clear process for reviewing, categorizing and distributing creator-generated content.

  • Evaluate content based on brand alignment, creative quality, audience relevance and potential commercial use.

  • Work with Paid Media, Creative and Marketplace to route creator content to its highest-value use: paid social, marketplace listings, email and brand channels.

  • Translate both organic and paid media learnings back into creator briefs so creators can produce stronger, more testable content.

  • Supply the brand social channels with a steady flow of approved, on-brand creator content. Publishing and community management on brand-owned accounts sit with a separate role.

7. Own Tools, Vendors and Operational Excellence

  • Manage our external partners - the TikTok consultant and content agencies - including scope, output quality, cost and the decision on when capability should move in-house.

  • Own the influencer marketing stack end to end. We currently run SARAL; assess whether it, Modash, Lefty or an alternative best serves discovery, outreach, relationship management and reporting at our volume.

  • Partner with Supply and Operations teams to ensure product kits are shipped accurately and on time.

  • Oversee creator invoicing and payment workflows, ensuring submissions are accurate, approved and processed promptly.

  • Identify bottlenecks and introduce scalable workflows, automation and documentation where appropriate.

7. Measure and Improve Performance

  • You'll be measured on four things: TikTok Shop affiliate GMV, cost per usable content asset, branded search and marketplace lift attributable to creator activity, and content throughput against quality standard. Everything else is diagnostic.

  • You'll manage a defined creator and sampling budget across both programs, with authority to reallocate between seeding and affiliate based on returns.

  • Define and monitor the KPIs required to evaluate the health and commercial impact of the influencer program.

  • Track outreach volume, open and response rates, approval rates, creator acquisition costs, content delivery, engagement, reach, conversions and return on investment.

  • Build clear weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting for the Growth team and company leadership.

  • Analyze performance by creator profile, product, platform, partnership structure, outreach message and content format.

  • Maintain a structured testing roadmap covering outreach messages, incentives, creator segments and content approaches.

How You’ll Succeed

  • You combine strategic thinking with a willingness to remain close to execution.

  • You create clarity for your team, hold people accountable and help them improve.

  • You build a predictable pipeline of relevant creators and commercially valuable content.

  • You use data and experimentation to improve response rates, partnership quality and return on investment.

  • You can recognize creators who offer strong value beyond follower count alone.

  • You build effective partnerships across Creator Marketing, Paid Media, Creative, Supply, Email Marketing and E-commerce.

  • You introduce structure without slowing down execution.

  • You communicate clearly, act quickly and resolve problems before they affect campaigns.

  • You remain resourceful in a competitive market where budgets and creator expectations may not always align.

  • You care equally about relationship quality, operational accuracy and commercial outcomes.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or creator affiliate marketing, including at least one program you owned end to end with commercial accountability.

  • Operator experience running a TikTok Shop or comparable creator affiliate program, with GMV or revenue you were personally accountable for.

  • DTC or e-commerce experience in health and wellness, beauty, or another regulated consumer category.

  • Experience managing or mentoring team members, with evidence you raised their output rather than just reviewed it.

  • Experience managing external agencies, consultants or vendors: setting scope, holding quality, deciding when to bring work in-house.

  • Experience structuring and negotiating both flat-fee and performance-based partnerships.

  • Strong analytical skills and a track record of using campaign data to change decisions, not just report them.

  • Evidence of an AI or automation workflow you built or deployed that measurably increased throughput. Be ready to walk through what it does and what it saved.

Strongly preferred

  • Ownership of brand-owned organic social channels, not only creator programs. You understand how owned content and creator content compound.

  • Working knowledge of FTC material-connection disclosure and platform claim policy in a regulated category. You know what a creator cannot say about a supplement, and why the answer differs on TikTok and Meta.

  • Experience collaborating with Paid Media or Creative to repurpose creator content into performance advertising, including securing ad authorization at partnership time.

  • Hands-on with an influencer marketing platform - SARAL, Modash, Lefty or equivalent.

  • Experience running influencer or creator programs across multiple brands or product categories.

  • Experience partnering with healthcare professionals or subject-matter experts as brand partners.

  • Understanding of paid social creative testing and direct-response fundamentals.

  • Genuine interest in health, wellness, consumer behavior and social media culture.

raw.jobDescription:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys writing code, solving complex backend problems, and building reliable payment systems. The ideal candidate takes ownership from development to production, is comfortable debugging real-world issues, and can turn business requirements into robust technical solutions.

Experience with PIX is a strong advantage, but we also welcome strong Java backend engineers from payments, fintech, banking, and other transaction-intensive environments who can quickly learn the Brazilian payment ecosystem.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot to support PIX payment integrations and related payment flows in Brazil.

  • Implement and optimize payment processing capabilities, including payment initiation, transaction status management, reconciliation, and exception handling.

  • Integrate with Brazilian banks, payment service providers, and external financial systems through APIs and other integration mechanisms.

  • Build reliable, high-performance backend systems with a strong focus on transaction consistency, idempotency, fault tolerance, and system availability.

  • Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions to improve system stability and performance.

  • Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of payment services.

  • Support payment-related security, risk control, and compliance requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong hands-on backend development experience with Java and PIX, preferably using Spring Boot and related frameworks.

  • Experience with PIX, Brazilian payment systems, or integrations with Brazilian banks and local payment service providers.

  • Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, distributed systems, and database design.

  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL; familiarity with caching, messaging systems, and asynchronous processing is a plus.

Why Binance

  • Shape the future of finance
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice.
