These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Analytics Engineer - Finance
description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation. Your expertise in Python, DBT, SQL, and Databricks will drive operational efficiency, accelerate our month-end close, and deliver strategic insights that inform capital allocation and IPO readiness. This is a greenfield opportunity to own the analytics roadmap, work directly with Finance leadership, and build infrastructure that powers both scaling and compliance, all at a pivotal moment for Mews

What you would do

  • Design and develop analytical features that surface actionable insights for Finance leadership
  • Build, optimise and maintain production-ready ETL/ELT pipelines using DBT, Databricks and SQL
  • Create scalable data models and analytical solutions using modern data modelling techniques
  • Build and champion data quality and testing practices; catch errors before they reach stakeholders
  • Collaborate across Finance to translate business requirements into technical implementations
  • Advocate for modern data practices and continuous improvement of the stack

What you would bring

  • Hands-on production experience building and optimising ETL/ELT pipelines (minimum 3 years)
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python; strong experience with DBT or equivalent modern data transformation tools
  • Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms, or willingness to ramp quickly
  • Strong understanding of data modelling and analytics architecture
  • Comfort working autonomously and managing priorities with ambiguity; ability to break down complex problems
  • Demonstrated commitment to data quality, testing and accuracy; take pride in work that's been thoroughly validated
  • AI Fluency Level 3: In this role, you'll redesign how Finance approaches data discovery and analysis using AI—not just automating your own work, but building patterns and tools that shape how the whole team questions data and validates insights. You'll use AI to accelerate model development and testing, but critically, you'll actively question what it produces and know when to push back. You've built processes others follow; here, you'll do that with AI as a core enabler.
  • For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.

Nice to have

  • Experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI
  • Background working with regulated or governed data
  • Experience scaling analytics in fast-growing startups or scale-ups

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description: The DevSecOps Engineer at Shield AI is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating the software delivery infrastructure required to develop and deploy advanced autonomous systems for defence applications. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, cyber security, and defence systems engineering. The DevSecOps Engineer works alongside autonomy, software, systems, integration, and test engineers to create secure and reliable development environments and delivery pipelines that enable teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy mission critical software. The ideal candidate has a strong software and platform engineering background combined with significant experience operating within UK defence environments. They have a strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps, Secure by Design, cyber risk management, security assurance, and the delivery of software into classified and operational environments. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate secure development and deployment infrastructure for Shield AI autonomy and defence programmes. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable rapid, repeatable, and secure delivery of autonomy and mission software. Embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring security controls, testing, evidence, and assurance are integrated into engineering workflows rather than treated as separate activities. Apply UK MOD Secure by Design principles throughout the development lifecycle and help engineering teams understand and meet their responsibilities for cyber security and technical assurance. Work closely with software, autonomy, systems, cyber security, integration, and test engineers to establish development environments that support rapid engineering while meeting defence security requirements. Design and maintain development and deployment environments spanning cloud, on premises infrastructure, laboratory environments, simulation, hardware in the loop, and operational platforms. Enable secure software development and deployment across different security classifications and appropriately segmented development environments. Implement automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, software composition analysis, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement. Champion a DevSecOps culture where software engineers take ownership of the security, reliability, deployability, and operational performance of the systems they develop. Required Qualifications BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline. Significant experience delivering software or digital capabilities within UK defence or another highly regulated national security environment. Strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps and Secure by Design, including the integration of cyber security and risk management throughout the capability lifecycle. Experience applying MOD security policies, security assurance processes, and technical security requirements to software intensive defence programmes. Experience developing and operating CI/CD pipelines using modern source control, build, test, artefact management, and deployment technologies. Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, containerisation, and infrastructure automation Experience with technologies such as Git, GitLab or GitHub, or equivalent tooling. Desirable Qualifications Experience supporting DevSecOps, software delivery, or digital engineering activities across NATO nations or multinational defence programmes. Understanding of DevSecOps approaches, security frameworks, and software assurance practices used by other NATO nations, particularly the United States and European NATO partners. title: Account Executive - SMB Inbound (Inside Sales)
description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Mission Principale : En tant qu' Account Executive SMB , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de notre portefeuille clients en traitant l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la qualification des leads entrants jusqu’au closing. Votre focus sera les leads entrants non identifiés dans notre CRM , en dehors des sociétés déjà connues de notre base de données. Vous aurez pour objectif de transformer ces opportunités en contrats clients. Responsabilités : 1. Gestion du cycle de vente intégral : - Qualification des leads entrants : Identifier et prioriser les leads générés par le marketing ou d'autres canaux, avec un focus sur les entreprises SMB (1 à 5 juristes). - Compréhension des besoins clients : Mener des découvertes approfondies et efficaces pour comprendre les défis et besoins spécifiques des prospects afin de proposer la solution la plus adaptée. - Présentation des solutions : Démonstration de notre plateforme SaaS et de ses fonctionnalités en lien avec les enjeux des prospects. - Négociation et closing : Gérer la proposition de valeur, négocier les termes du contrat et finaliser les ventes jusqu'à la signature. 2. Suivi des opportunités commerciales : - Utilisation proactive du CRM pour tenir à jour les opportunités, le pipeline de vente, et assurer un suivi rigoureux des prospects. - Priorisation des opportunités les plus chaudes - Participer aux réunions hebdomadaires de revue du pipeline 3. Collaboration interservices : - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing , Produit et Customer Success pour assurer une excellente expérience client. - Remonter les feedbacks des prospects et clients pour améliorer le produit et les processus commerciaux. 4. Développement de la connaissance marché : - Maintenir une veille active sur les évolutions du secteur juridique et des besoins spécifiques des entreprises juridiques SMB. - Proposer des initiatives pour améliorer la qualification des leads et les stratégies de vente sur ce segment de marché. Objectifs et KPIs : - Honorer un nombre de volume rdvs journaliers issus de la qualification de leads entrants. - Taux de conversion des leads entrants en opportunités qualifiées. - Allier qualité et opportunisme dans traitement des salescycle pour convertir avec le meilleur Sales Cycle. - Atteinte des quotas de vente mensuels et trimestriels. Compétences requises : Expérience commerciale : Expérience significative en tant qu’Account Executive, Business Developer ou poste similaire, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS ou dans la vente de solutions B2B. Cycle de vente complet : Capacité prouvée à gérer un cycle de vente de bout en bout (qualification, négociation, closing). Orienté résultats : Forte capacité à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente, avec un excellent sens des priorités. Communication : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec des interlocuteurs variés. Qualités personnelles : Autonomie et proactivité : Capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement startup en forte croissance. Écoute active : Vous êtes à l’écoute des besoins de vos interlocuteurs et savez adapter votre discours en conséquence. Esprit d'équipe : Vous aimez collaborer avec les autres départements pour atteindre des objectifs communs. Adaptabilité : Vous êtes flexible et capable de vous adapter rapidement aux changements dans un environnement en constante évolution. Résilience : Vous avez une forte capacité à surmonter les obstacles et à persévérer pour atteindre vos objectifs. Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert. Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc. Nos valeurs 🤝 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses. description: Le rôle Équiper des équipes de LLM et de coding agents prend un après-midi. Comme Tech Lead, tu aides nos clients à comprendre ces transformations, tu arbitres les décisions d'architecture qui en découlent et tu mets en place les capacités qui leur manquent. Leur question porte maintenant sur l'intégration des agents au SI et au cycle de delivery, et sur ce qui doit être mutualisé dans une plateforme plutôt que laissé à chaque équipe. Ce sont des questions d'architecture, et on n'a personne dont c'est le métier à plein temps. Chez Thiga : nos Product Builders, Product Engineers et consultants Product. Ton rôle est de construire les enablers technologiques qui leur permettent de tirer parti de l'IA sur leurs missions, et de les faire progresser. Ton profil 🚀 Une culture Tech large Tu es d'abord un bon technologue. Tu comprends assez bien les systèmes logiciels modernes pour raisonner sur une architecture entière : software architecture, systèmes distribués, APIs, données, cloud, infrastructure, sécurité, IAM, CI/CD, developer platforms, observabilité. On cherche quelqu'un capable de repérer ce qui est structurant, de comprendre les interactions entre les couches et d'aller en profondeur quand le problème l'exige, plutôt qu'un spécialiste de chacune de ces disciplines. Tu as assez de kilomètres au compteur, souvent une dizaine d'années, pour avoir vu des architectures évoluer, atteindre leurs limites et parfois échouer. Une vraie profondeur IA Tu comprends les systèmes construits avec des LLM et des agents, ce qu'ils permettent et où ils coincent. Context engineering, retrieval, tool use, systèmes agentiques, evals, sécurité, observabilité : tu sais raisonner sur les propriétés architecturales que ces systèmes introduisent et sur ce qu'elles impliquent pour le reste du SI. title: Data Product Manager H/F
description: En tant que Data Product Manager, tu seras en immersion au sein des équipes de nos clients. Tu travailleras pour des sociétés allant de la startup française au grand groupe international, dans des secteurs aussi divers que les transports, l’assurance, le luxe, la musique, le tourisme ou encore la banque en ligne. Que ce soit pour identifier et cadrer les cas d’usage pertinents pour lancer un nouveau Produit Data ou pour accompagner le développement au sein d’une équipe de Data Scientists et Data Engineers, nos Data PM sont là pour apporter une vision et une démarche produit sur des sujets de pointe ! Ta mission au quotidien : Identifier et prioriser les besoins utilisateurs et business du client Définir la stratégie et roadmap du produit. Etablir une vision produit “claire” identifier les incertitudes et mettre en place les démarches pertinentes pour les lever Savoir définir le MVP d’un Produit Data et les itérations qui permettront d’atteindre la vision Analyser les performances techniques et métier du produit, identifier les leviers d’amélioration et animer la co-création de solutions pertinentes Déterminer, rédiger et prioriser les fonctionnalités du produit sous forme d’Epics et d’User Stories avec les équipes métiers, business et technique. Créer et s’assurer de la bonne tenue de ton backlog. Suivre les différentes cérémonies agiles comme : le sprint planning, les daily meetings, des rétrospectives, des démonstrations au client. Collaborer avec l’UX Designer pour concevoir l'expérience utilisateur. Participer à la mise en place de tests utilisateurs et en analyser les retours. Maintenir la roadmap à court et moyen termes en prenant en compte les impacts business et les contraintes de développement. Communiquer auprès de l’ensemble des parties prenantes. Associate Partner/Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness
London, UK

About Ekimetrics

Ekimetrics transforms how organisations make critical business decisions. We combine our Eki.Decisions platform with embedded experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science, connecting decisions across business domains to drive real, scalable and lasting impact. Our dual purpose is Competitiveness and Sustainability, because lasting leadership is built on both.

With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong and Shanghai, we are committed to responsibility and frugality in AI, and to staying loyal to our values and DNA.

The opportunity

Marketing budgets are under the microscope, CFOs want proof, and AI is rewriting how performance is measured. Ekimetrics sits at the centre of that shift. Since 2006, we have helped some of the world’s leading brands turn Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and AI-powered measurement into confident investment decisions.

As an Associate Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness, you will be a senior leader of our London office. You will own a portfolio of strategic clients, shape how we grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business in the UK and build the next generation of Ekimetrics talent. You will work alongside the London General Manager and be trusted with increasing autonomy and strategic ownership.

What you will do

Lead strategic clients and world-class MMM delivery
  • Lead a portfolio of strategic, multi-account clients, or a major programme for a Tier 1 client, as Key Account Manager.
  • Define and drive the road map for each programme, from MMM and marketing effectiveness through to commercial and business-wide effectiveness, using our solutions model and the Eki.Decisions platform.
  • Safeguard scientific quality: robust MMM and econometrics, causal inference, incrementality and experimentation, and models clients can understand and trust.
  • Turn model outputs into decisions: budget optimisation, scenario planning and forecasting that change how clients allocate their investment.
  • Steer the delivery excellence, impact and profitability of your portfolio, securing the right teams for every programme.
  • Build and manage relationships with key media, platform and technology partners to drive innovation and growth across our accounts.
  • Share best practice and reusable assets across the Ekimetrics community.

Grow the business

  • Build long-term, trusted relationships with CMOs, CFOs and commercial leaders, securing renewals and positioning Ekimetrics as their strategic partner.
  • Identify and convert growth opportunities across your accounts, extending the value we deliver as client needs evolve.
  • Lead pitches and RFPs to win new logos and keep a strong pipeline.
  • Be the face of Ekimetrics in the market: speak at conferences and client forums, and lead thought leadership on the future of measurement, including AI and GenAI.
Build the team and the UK office
  • Lead by example, managing and coaching a team through regular 1:1s, performance reviews and talent assessments.
  • Play a key role in recruiting, developing and retaining top talent in London, and in succession planning for the office.

  • Champion our culture and values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity and Enjoyment.

description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Wingtra builds professional drones that help people map and understand the world. Join the team creating our next aircraft and the tools that build and test it. You’ll be a hands-on generalist who combines mechatronic design and system integration. You’ll work for drone operators and for our colleagues on the production floor. We’re early adopters of AI and build agents into everyday engineering. We want you to keep expanding what we can design, build and test. Responsibilities Design what flies and what attaches to it. You design, integrate and qualify mechanical and mechatronic assemblies for the drone and its accessories. That covers mounts and interfaces, plus sensors and actuators working together. You team up with our electronics designers and suppliers to get designs that can be manufactured. Build the rigs that prove it. You develop qualification rigs and production QC setups. You design fixtures and adapters in CAD, integrate PCBAs and instruments and wire sensors and actuators. Then you bring up the whole system, debug and iterate it until it’s reliable. Automate the checks. You integrate a Raspberry Pi and write Python tools for flashing, calibration and end-of-line checks. You build the operator interface with serial-number traceability and robust data pipeline. Make every test mean something. You design for testability. You use requirements and FMEA to define tests and to justify pass/fail limits. You validate measurement accuracy and repeatability, diagnose faults and improve production yield. Take it to the line. You commission QC stations with the Production Engineers on shared infrastructure. You support their takeover and resolve issues through ramp-up. You leave behind tools and documentation they can maintain. Requirements You have depth in one engineering discipline. You’ve also integrated mechanics, electronics and software into systems that work. We value complementary strengths and practical ownership across disciplines. You enjoy product design and test engineering alike. Building tools that make your colleagues on the production floor faster and happier is part of the fun. AI agents already help you learn, design, code and analyze. You check what they produce, invent better workflows and share what works with the team. You prototype fast, debug systematically and keep going until something is reliable enough for someone else to use. You’ll sit in the Engineering team with real ownership, from the first concept to a working production line. You’re based in Zurich. During commissioning and ramp-up, you’ll spend time with our production partners in Europe and the USA. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
description: TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself. What You'll Do Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases. Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints. Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release. Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through. Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed. Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality. Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong. Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs. Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio. What You'll Need Leadership & Product Team Experience A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you. A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on. A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers. Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release. Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users. Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result. Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving. Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning. Cartography & Digital Map Making A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn. Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation. Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms. Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data. Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names. Map Visualisation & Rendering Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail. Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance. Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering. Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations. AI in Your Practice Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down. Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye. Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing. Senior-Level Craft & Collaboration 5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience. Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering. Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout. User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving. High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making. Nice to Have Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation. Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way. Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar. Understanding of the automotive, fleet management or logistics industries and their mapping requirements. Familiarity with emerging trends in spatial computing, AR navigation or digital twins. Experience contributing to design systems at scale. What we offer A competitive compensation package, of course. Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location. Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage. As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap. What you'll do Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality. Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog. Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively. Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage. Lead brainstorms and drive product exploration through prototypes and wireframes. Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves. Data acumen — able to analyze data from multiple sources, such as GPS traces, probes, STOs, camera observations, and traffic authorities, to drive decisions and assess tradeoffs. Build strong cross-functional relationships and steer the product team by removing blockers and escalating appropriately. Communicate effectively to internal teams (automotive, navigation, delivery) and external stakeholders using customer problem statements and business logic; deliver concise presentations and lead meetings from standups to stakeholder reviews. Maintain product strategy and vision, and contribute to broader Traffic discussions; formulate compelling value propositions tied to articulated problems and product metrics. Establish yourself as the subject-matter expert and go-to person for live and historical traffic data products, maintaining trust across product and business teams with visible, citable personal impact. What you'll need A minimum of 5 years' experience as a Product Manager, preferably in traffic, geospatial, mobility, or automotive domains. A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field. Familiarity with real-time data processing, GPS/probe data, or traffic and mobility analytics (preferred). Experience or technical training in data science, analytics, or related disciplines. Strong ability to understand, articulate, and represent customer needs and requirements. Proven ability to coordinate people and technical resources across multiple teams. Effective time management and strong interpersonal communication skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with senior technical and executive audiences. Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills and creative, structured thinking. What we offer A competitive compensation package, of course. Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location. Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. Meet your team We’re the User Experience Design team. Fueled by user insights and data analytics, our mission is to create powerful, easy-to-use products that delight our customers, from millions of drivers to automotive customers who embed our technologies in their vehicles. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Together, we'll continue to develop a map that people trust all around the world. At TomTom... You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet. Work with a team of 3,600+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them. After you apply Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs . TomTom is an equal opportunity employer TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you . No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. title: Senior Developer, Growth
description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. We are seeking a back-end leaning Senior Developer to join our Growth Team, focused on building net-new self-serve experiences, evolving the underlying systems and integrations that power Product Growth, and driving rapid experimentation and feedback loops across our expanding B2B product suites. How we’re using AI today Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US. What we're looking for: 5+ years of professional software development experience in a production SaaS environment. Strong experience building backend services in a modern language (e.g. Go, Node.js, Ruby, or Python). Deep experience with React and/or TypeScript in customer-facing web applications. Strong understanding of instrumentation, analytics, and defining meaningful success metrics. Ability to operate autonomously, drive initiatives forward, and influence technical direction. Strong collaboration skills and a growth mindset. Bonus points for: Demonstrated experience leading or significantly contributing to experimentation-driven product development. Familiarity with analytics platforms (e.g., Amplitude, Looker, Qualtrics). Experience working in security- or compliance-sensitive domains. What you can expect: Shape and evolve our experimentation platform (feature flags, instrumentation, data quality, reporting loops). Lead the design and implementation of experiments that drive activation, engagement, and expansion. Partner closely with product, design, and data to refine hypotheses, define measurable outcomes, and interpret results. Balance rapid iteration with long-term architectural health and security. Raise the bar for code quality, observability, and performance across the team. Mentor engineers through code reviews, technical design discussions, and pairing. Identify technical opportunities to unlock new growth mechanisms. See your work directly influence measurable customer and business outcomes. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $153,000 USD and $214,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $144,000 CAD and $202,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others. Our approach to remote work We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. What we offer We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing Maternity and parental leave top-up programs Competitive health benefits Generous PTO policy Growth and future RSU program for most employees Retirement matching program Free 1Password account Community Paid volunteer days Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly Remote-first work environment *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. You belong here. 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you. title: Engineering Manager - 3P and Catalog

Partner Integrations connects that data - and associated inventory, promotions, orders, and fulfillment workflows - to marketplaces, strategic partners, and retail platforms such as Shopify. Together, these teams ensure products are accurately represented, sellable and fulfillable across Gopuff’s first-party and partner channels. If you are a driven and experienced engineering manager, we would love to hear from you. This position will involve a combination of hands-on engineering and people management. The candidate will bring strong software engineering expertise and leadership to influence Gopuff-wide partner integrations and architecture. The ideal candidate will be an experienced engineering leader with an interest in both the technical and product management aspects of engineering. Collaborate with engineering and product leadership to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions Scope, decompose, and organize projects for multiple teammates. Delegate tasks and coordinate teammates to bring those projects to completion with minimal oversight. Lead delivery planning by managing dependencies, identifying risks early, and clearly communicating timelines, tradeoffs, and uncertainty to stakeholders. Manage project timelines, resource allocation, and team performance, ensuring that deliverables are met on schedule and within scope Provide clear technical direction and support for the teams, ensuring the successful execution of data platform projects and initiatives Drive continuous improvement within the team by developing practices around professional development, performance management, and hiring Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software solutions. Implement system and data monitors to ensure the correctness of the business process Support standard development practices across your team, including idiomatic syntax, design patterns, and Testing/Quality Practice Oversee operational support and engineering for multiple large distributed software applications Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role 3+ years of engineering management experience Experience collaborating with functional stakeholders and establishing a roadmap that aligns with business priorities Experience with organizational design, team development, hiring, and performance management Experience deploying applications and service to Kubernetes and using related tools in the Kubernetes ecosystem (i.e. Helm, ArgoCD, Istio) Experience with Infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform Public cloud experience in a production setting (Azure preferred) Proficiency with SQL, Postgres, Java, Typescript Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms and their application in building Data intensive applications that process high velocity data (millions of transactions) or high volume data (transactions impacting millions of records) Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Experience with message based, async processing Experience with Javascript & SPA technology in a production setting (ex: React) Experience with the Shopify platform is a plus Compensation Gopuff pays employees based on market pricing and pay may vary depending on your location. About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role

The AI Automation Engineer will work across different areas of the company to identify opportunities where AI and automation can improve processes, reduce manual work, and support more scalable operations.

This is a hands-on role combining technical implementation, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration. You will help take automation initiatives from initial idea and requirements through implementation, testing, documentation, and ongoing improvement.

You will also help ensure that AI-powered workflows are implemented responsibly, with appropriate human oversight, controls, documentation, and monitoring—particularly when working with sensitive, financial, or customer-related processes.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, implement, and maintain AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across different business functions.

  • Partner with teams across the organization to understand existing processes, identify automation opportunities, and translate business needs into practical technical solutions.

  • Support AI automation projects from scoping and design through testing, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Integrate AI tools and agents with existing systems, data sources, APIs, and business workflows.

  • Implement appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, monitoring, logging, and audit trails within automated processes.

  • Troubleshoot and improve existing automations to enhance reliability, performance, and scalability.

  • Maintain clear technical and process documentation for implemented solutions.

  • Collaborate with Compliance, Product, Technology, Operations, and other teams to ensure solutions align with business, security, and regulatory requirements.

  • Stay current with developments in AI agents, automation frameworks, and related technologies, and evaluate their potential application within Airtm.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building or implementing AI-powered automations, AI agents, or agentic workflows.

  • Experience with automation platforms, APIs, integrations, or workflow orchestration tools.

  • Experience with Claude, OpenClaw, or similar AI and agent development tools.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate business processes into practical technical solutions.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, including human oversight, access controls, monitoring, and documentation.

  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage projects and priorities across different teams.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated environment is valued, but we also welcome candidates with relevant AI and automation experience from other industries.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AML, KYC, fraud prevention, compliance, or other financial-services processes.

  • Experience working with SQL, data tools, APIs, or Google Workspace.

  • Experience implementing AI or automation solutions in regulated or control-focused environments.

  • Familiarity with AI governance, auditability, monitoring, or model and automation controls.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Senior Software Engineer - Go & Rust, Blockchain Infrastructure
description: Quicknode is a cloud-based infrastructure company that powers the blockchain ecosystem. Our mission is to be the indispensable utility that empowers companies and innovators globally to build next-generation, Web3 enabled businesses & applications using blockchain technology. Quicknode is backed by some of the world's best investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, SoftBank, and the Seven Seven Six Fund. The Quicknode team has over 110 people maintaining high performance global data infrastructure for amazing customers serving billions of requests daily. We are a global remote company with offices in Fort Lauderdale, FL and Lisbon, Portugal. The Role Quicknode deploys institutional-grade infrastructure - Core RPC API, Streams, Webhooks, Clusters, and developer tooling - across 80+ blockchain networks for teams building onchain. The Engineering team behind this infrastructure needs a senior individual contributor who can design, build, and improve the distributed systems that ingest, process, and serve blockchain data at scale, working across both Go and Rust. This is a hands-on engineering and technical-leadership role for someone who moves comfortably between high-throughput Go services and performance- and security-critical Rust components. You will own complex systems from design through production and raise the engineering bar on reliability, performance, security, and operational quality. This role reports into Engineering leadership for the Blockchain Infrastructure team and carries no direct reports at this level. As scope grows, you will take on larger system ownership, mentor other engineers, and help set engineering standards adopted across teams - a natural path toward Staff or Principal Engineer. What You'll Do Design, build, and optimize high-throughput, low-latency backend services, APIs, and data-processing systems in both Go and Rust for production blockchain infrastructure. Own production Go services and Rust components, including their architecture, interfaces, concurrency models, memory and resource efficiency, testing, observability, deployment, and operation. Architect distributed systems that ingest, process, validate, and serve blockchain data with strong guarantees around consistency, fault tolerance, scalability, and availability. Own technical work end to end, including requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement. Profile and benchmark production systems, identify bottlenecks, and improve throughput, latency, resource efficiency, resilience, and correctness under load. Assess security risks in blockchain and distributed-system components and design or review controls that protect transactions, data, credentials, and system integrity. Debug complex failures across services, databases, streaming systems, networks, and blockchain nodes, then drive durable root-cause fixes. Partner with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Developer Experience teams to translate customer and protocol requirements into maintainable systems. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, document important decisions, and establish engineering standards that improve quality across teams. What You'll Bring Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience building and operating backend or distributed systems in high-scale production environments. Advanced professional proficiency in both Go and Rust, with demonstrated experience shipping and operating production software in each language. Go and Rust are both core requirements for this role, not interchangeable alternatives. Deep knowledge of distributed systems, algorithms and data structures, concurrency, memory safety and ownership, databases, networking, operating systems, and production software architecture. A record of delivering reliable, scalable systems with measurable improvements in performance, availability, correctness, or developer experience. Experience with blockchain infrastructure, high-throughput APIs, node or RPC infrastructure, data-streaming pipelines, or similarly demanding distributed platforms. Experience applying secure-design principles, threat modeling, and disciplined testing to systems where correctness and availability are critical. Strong written and verbal communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to lead ambiguous, cross-team projects without constant direction. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Ethereum, Solana, or other major blockchain protocols and their node, RPC, indexing, or transaction-processing architecture. Experience designing clean interfaces between Go services and Rust systems, libraries, or performance-sensitive components. Experience designing or reviewing cryptographic, wallet, signing, custody, or other security-sensitive systems. Experience with streaming and data infrastructure such as Kafka, queues, event-driven services, distributed databases, or large-scale observability systems. Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture ownership, mentorship, incident leadership, or engineering standards adopted by multiple teams. Quicknode deploys institutional-grade infrastructure - Core RPC API, Streams, Webhooks, Clusters, and developer tooling - across 80+ blockchain networks for teams building onchain. The Engineering team behind this infrastructure needs a senior individual contributor who can design, build, and improve the distributed systems that ingest, process, and serve blockchain data at scale, working across both Go and Rust.

This is a hands-on engineering and technical-leadership role for someone who moves comfortably between high-throughput Go services and performance- and security-critical Rust components. You will own complex systems from design through production and raise the engineering bar on reliability, performance, security, and operational quality.

This role reports into Engineering leadership for the Blockchain Infrastructure team and carries no direct reports at this level. As scope grows, you will take on larger system ownership, mentor other engineers, and help set engineering standards adopted across teams - a natural path toward Staff or Principal Engineer.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and optimize high-throughput, low-latency backend services, APIs, and data-processing systems in both Go and Rust for production blockchain infrastructure.

  • Own production Go services and Rust components, including their architecture, interfaces, concurrency models, memory and resource efficiency, testing, observability, deployment, and operation.

  • Architect distributed systems that ingest, process, validate, and serve blockchain data with strong guarantees around consistency, fault tolerance, scalability, and availability.

  • Own technical work end to end, including requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement.

  • Profile and benchmark production systems, identify bottlenecks, and improve throughput, latency, resource efficiency, resilience, and correctness under load.

  • Assess security risks in blockchain and distributed-system components and design or review controls that protect transactions, data, credentials, and system integrity.

  • Debug complex failures across services, databases, streaming systems, networks, and blockchain nodes, then drive durable root-cause fixes.

  • Partner with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Developer Experience teams to translate customer and protocol requirements into maintainable systems.

  • Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, document important decisions, and establish engineering standards that improve quality across teams.

What You'll Bring

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience building and operating backend or distributed systems in high-scale production environments.

  • Advanced professional proficiency in both Go and Rust, with demonstrated experience shipping and operating production software in each language. Go and Rust are both core requirements for this role, not interchangeable alternatives.

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems, algorithms and data structures, concurrency, memory safety and ownership, databases, networking, operating systems, and production software architecture.

  • A record of delivering reliable, scalable systems with measurable improvements in performance, availability, correctness, or developer experience.

  • Experience with blockchain infrastructure, high-throughput APIs, node or RPC infrastructure, data-streaming pipelines, or similarly demanding distributed platforms.

  • Experience applying secure-design principles, threat modeling, and disciplined testing to systems where correctness and availability are critical.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to lead ambiguous, cross-team projects without constant direction.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Ethereum, Solana, or other major blockchain protocols and their node, RPC, indexing, or transaction-processing architecture.

  • Experience designing clean interfaces between Go services and Rust systems, libraries, or performance-sensitive components.

  • Experience designing or reviewing cryptographic, wallet, signing, custody, or other security-sensitive systems.

  • Experience with streaming and data infrastructure such as Kafka, queues, event-driven services, distributed databases, or large-scale observability systems.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture ownership, mentorship, incident leadership, or engineering standards adopted by multiple teams.

title: Engineering Manager - Data Platform
description: Within the Data Platform studio, we own two critical pillars: our event delivery platform that collects trillions of events per day from producers to consumers, and another, which handles the pseudonymisation of data so Spotify can use data responsibly and in compliance with privacy regulations. These systems sit at the heart of Spotify's data collection and are used by hundreds of teams across the company. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of six experienced engineers distributed across Europe. You'll set the technical direction, ensure the team delivers high-impact work, and - just as importantly - invest deeply in the growth and careers of your engineers. If you're energised by both the technical challenges of large-scale data systems and the human side of building a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you. What You’ll Do Lead and develop a team of six experienced engineers, with a strong focus on coaching, career development, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers. Take accountability for the team's delivery, ensuring clear priorities, healthy execution, and measurable outcomes. Partner with product and stakeholders to shape the roadmap for event delivery and privacy infrastructure. Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions for systems operating at Spotify scale. Build a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and continuous improvement. Collaborate across Data Platform and the wider engineering organisation to align on shared goals and dependencies. Manage on-call health, operational excellence, and reliability for the team's services. Actively participate in hiring, onboarding, and growing the team's capabilities. Who You Are You have experience managing teams of senior/experienced engineers and understand that people leadership is your primary craft, not a side responsibility. You have a track record of investing in engineers' careers - running meaningful development conversations, helping people grow into new roles, and creating clarity around expectations and progression. You're comfortable with distributed data systems, event-driven architectures, or data infrastructure at scale - you don't need to write the code, but you can engage credibly in technical discussions and unblock your team. You hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes, not just activity. You communicate clearly and build trust across functions and time zones. You've worked with distributed teams and understand how to create cohesion and inclusion when people aren't in the same room. You're excited about the potential of AI and LLMs to transform how engineering teams work - whether that's accelerating development workflows, rethinking how data infrastructure is built and operated, or helping your team adopt AI-assisted tooling effectively. Where You’ll Be This role is based in London. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Compensation Additional Information Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

title: ZK Proof Engineer
description: About Us Axiom is using zero-knowledge proofs to enable new types of verifiable and private software applications, starting with crypto and fintech. We are a small but incredibly strong team backed by the best investors in crypto . We’re looking for exceptional people who are excited to work on challenging and impactful problems in a fast-paced environment. Our office is in NYC and working in person in NY is our strong preference, but we're open to remote candidates as well. We recently released OpenVM , a performant and modular zkVM framework built for customization and extensibility. OpenVM allows developers to verify the correct execution of arbitrary computer programs in a flexible and performant way. We are building ZK-enabled products using OpenVM and supporting teams building on OpenVM. The Role We are looking for a ZK Proof Engineer who will implement and optimize cutting-edge cryptographic code for zero-knowledge proof generation. You will be responsible for building systems to interface between low-level computer systems like the RISC-V ISA, compiler frameworks like LLVM, and database backends and connecting them with cutting-edge zero-knowledge proof systems. The role will involve both optimizing ZK provers and implementing novel ZK circuits. Your work will require making design choices to enable rapid development of secure and efficient systems. We are looking for someone with strong engineering design skills, the ability to work across the stack, and a security mindset. We also value the ability to make pragmatic technology choices which empower our small team without adding too much overhead. Who you are You have a strong background in math/cryptography, or strong problem-solving skills and interest in zero-knowledge proofs. You have proficiency in Rust, C/C++, or a similarly performant backend language. We work primarily in Rust. You are extremely detail oriented and have a security mindset. You’ve worked on challenging software projects and have an eye for performance. You’re a clear communicator and value collaboration. You have a strong bias towards action. You have an extremely strong work ethic. Bonuses You have experience with compiler frameworks like LLVM or MLIR. You've worked with aspects of low level computer architecture like RISC-V or programmed FGPAs or other custom hardware. You have experience with database backends, including experience with query planning or low level query engines. You've done research in mathematics, theoretical computer science, or theoretical physics. You have experience with low-level details of Ethereum We welcome diverse backgrounds. Some non-traditional profiles that may be a good fit include high-frequency trading, math/physics/CS academia, and hardware engineering. Why join us You’ll be one of the earliest employees with ownership to make key technical/product decisions. You’ll be working on groundbreaking tech that has the potential to be a key piece of infrastructure for the crypto industry. You’ll receive a competitive salary with equity. You will work with and receive mentorship from an exceptional team. Our Team Our founders Yi Sun and Jonathan Wang met while studying math at Harvard and have been working on ZK since 2021. Together, they wrote some of the most performant ZK circuits for elliptic curve cryptography and Ethereum data reads before starting Axiom. Before Axiom, Yi was a professor at UChicago Statistics and did a math PhD at MIT. He was previously an advisor for Gauntlet and worked at an HFT startup from inception to profitable trading. Jonathan published number theory research in top math journals and did a math PhD at UChicago. The rest of our small but incredibly strong team includes alums of Applied Intuition, Coinbase, Color, Neon, Google, and Perplexity as well as math / CS PhDs and IMO / IPhO / Codeforces winners. We look forward to working with you!
