raw.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're building agents that run real parts of our business, take on real work, and get better based on the results they produce. You'll build them with whatever is most capable right now: our own agents platform, the latest orchestration tools, and frontier models. The hard part is making them reliable, measurable, and safe enough for the business to depend on.

You'll sit in Marketing Engineering and be forward-deployed to our growth pods, where you'll find the problems worth solving and own the solutions end to end. You might be a forward-deployed builder, an applied AI engineer who has taken agents beyond the demo stage, or a full-stack engineer who is curious about growth.

Requirements

  • Python, SQL, LLM APIs and agent orchestration

  • You've shipped production systems that other people relied on, starting from a vague problem

  • You've built with LLMs beyond a demo and know how to evaluate them and where they fail

  • You measure whether what you built worked

  • Bonus: experience with GTM data or marketing systems.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

raw.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.

Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible.

What you will do:

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies.

  • Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers.

Requirements

  • Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity

  • Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

    Location

    This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United Kingdom. There is a preference for candidates to be based in London, with the option to work out of our office. Expect regular travel for customer onsites.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

An overview of this role The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it. A strong point of view on the validation gap and concrete ideas for closing it, backed by approaches you've built or tried. Experience designing distributed systems designed to run on Kubernetes first. The technical range to design systems rather than tune a single framework, and the judgment to know when a solution should be general or language-specific. You prototype to learn, and you ship. The ability to influence engineers across an organization without formal authority through working code and sound reasoning. Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency. This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We aren't looking for depth in a particular testing framework. We're looking for someone who has built with agents, experienced the validation gap firsthand, and wants to solve it. About the team The Trusted Agentic Development team is part of GitLab's Developer Experience group. We build platforms and practices that help GitLab engineers validate agent-generated software with confidence. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt. title: Software Engineer II - Embedded Platform
description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

 

Your Role

We’re looking for an Engineer II to join our Platform squad working on one of Hudl’s most innovative products: next-generation, fully automated sports cameras. These autonomous cameras use edge AI to automatically track the action and upload to the cloud, giving our customers seamless access to vital, real-time video and insights.

The Platform squad builds the foundation our hardware teams rely on - the build systems, tooling, update pipeline and security processes that take our cameras from development through manufacturing and into the field. As we bring up our next-generation hardware platform, you’ll help shape how it’s built, tested, shipped and kept secure.

As an Engineer II, you’ll:

  • Support our hardware squads. You’ll help hardware squads integrate their work into our CI/CD pipelines, so every change is built, tested and delivered reliably.
  • Build development tools. You’ll create and improve the tools our engineers use every day to build, flash, debug and test devices.
  • Keep our infrastructure running. You’ll maintain our CI/CD infrastructure, including the regression testing that runs in manufacturing.
  • Ship updates to the field. You’ll roll out software updates to our customers’ cameras safely and predictably.
  • Enable manufacturing. You’ll provide the tooling our contract manufacturers use to flash, provision and test devices on the production line.
  • Own the problem. You’ll work in an autonomous squad that has the freedom and expertise to deliver the best solution.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of Den Bosch. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Yocto experience. You’ve worked with Yocto and are comfortable building and customizing images.
  • CI/CD know-how. You’ve built or maintained CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitHub Actions, GitLab or Jenkins), including build automation and automated testing.
  • Scripting and tooling skills. You write clean, maintainable tools and automation in Bash and Python, and you’re comfortable with Docker and Linux system administration.
  • Comfortable withAI-assisted development. You work fluently with AI coding tools and can evaluate their output critically.

Nice-to-Haves

  • OTA update experience. You’ve worked with over-the-air update frameworks.
  • Manufacturing experience. You’ve built flashing, provisioning or end-of-line test tooling for production environments.
  • Embedded platform experience. You’ve worked with SoC vendor BSPs, flashing tools or secure boot on platforms.
  • Low-level development. You’re comfortable reading and debugging C/C++ code, from user space down to kernel drivers.
  • Security vulnerability management. You have experience identifying, triaging and resolving security vulnerabilities in embedded Linux systems.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.  
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range
€51.000—€85.000 EUR

title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform
description: We are looking for a product-minded AI engineer to turn what our customers are trying to decide into agents they actually rely on. AskWaive, our in-product assistant, is already live; the work now is quality, coverage, and an experience that wows. This is not a role for a prompt author or a demo builder. We want an owner: someone who takes a customer need—already expressed through our serving layers and semantic layer—and turns it into an endpoint, a tool, and an experience that makes the customer measurably better at their job. Agent engineering, deployment, and testing are all part of delivery, not a handoff. Our core data platform is owned by the team that built it. You'll build on top of it—and where data or infrastructure is holding an agent back, you'll have the standing to propose the change and drive it. What You'll Do From Customer Need to Product Superpower Own the Outcome: Start from the customer, and stay with it until the agent is answering their needs better Build Agents and Tools: Build production agents and the tools they call—retrieval, multi-step workflows, action-taking—on Amazon Bedrock, with Bedrock AgentCore as our runtime and tools exposed over MCP (Model Context Protocol). Turn Serving Layers Into Capability: Our semantic layer and service APIs are where customer needs are already expressed. Your job is turning them into endpoints and tools an agent can wield well—and knowing which metrics and entities it should reach at all. Shape the Experience, Not Just the Endpoint: How an answer arrives—its speed, its confidence, its explanation, the next step it offers—is the product. A technically correct response a customer ignores is a failure. Prove It and Make It Felt Measure Groundedness: Build the eval harness—labeled test sets, groundedness and hallucination rates you can put a number on, and CI gates that stop a regression before it ships. Measure What Customers Got: Adoption, feedback, intent—then report realized impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up. Diagnose and Iterate: Instrument the tracing that shows why an answer was wrong, turn each failure mode into a specific fix, and ship again. This loop is the job, not a phase of it. Deliver Ship and Operate: Own the serving path—MCP endpoints, latency, cost per response, caching, and runtime guardrails. Deployment and testing are part of the job, not a handoff. Embed and Influence: Partner with Product Managers and engineers on which decisions an agent should support—and which it shouldn't. Where data or infrastructure limits what an agent can do, drive the change alongside the team that owns the platform. Who You Are The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions with the agent's help, not by whether it shipped. The Agent Builder: You've taken an agent past the demo. You know the hard part is everything after it works once—coverage, grounding, cost, and the failure modes you only see at scale. You fix problems without waiting for a ticket. The Experience Obsessive: You care how an answer lands, not just whether it was right. Trustworthy, fast, and legible beats clever. We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you are a builder who cares about the "why" behind the code, we want to hear from you! HOW WE WORK We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next task faster for the whole team. The leverage is in the verification: the tests, CI gates, and typed interfaces that make agent-written code safe to merge. What You"ll Bring Experience: 5+ years building production software or data-intensive systems used by real customers, with strong Python skills—including at least one LLM or agent feature you shipped to production users. AWS & Agent Stack: Hands-on AWS experience, ideally Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. Equivalent agent runtimes transfer, but we build on AWS and you'll be productive faster if you have prior exposure. Agent Engineering: Orchestration, tool and function design, context assembly, and multi-step workflows—you've made the design calls, not just the prompt calls. Retrieval & Domain Grounding: You've built retrieval over real business data, you can explain how context gets selected and why an answer was wrong, and you have enough SQL and metric fluency to catch an agent answering with the wrong number. Evaluation & Iteration: You've built or owned an eval loop for a generative system—labelled sets, regression gates, and a number you could defend when someone asked whether it got better. Product Sense for AI: You have opinions about how an agent should behave—when to answer, when to ask, when to refuse, how to show its work—and you've shipped those opinions, not just argued them. Measurement & Narrative: You've quantified what an agent actually delivered for users—adoption, task success, decision quality—and presented it to people who were never going to read your traces. Working With Agents: You've used coding agents on real production work, you can tell correct output from merely plausible output, and you invest in the harnesses that make the next task faster. Communication & Collaboratio n: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working across technical and non-technical teams. Bonus Points For: LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith, or Arize). Semantic layer or metrics-layer design (Ossie, dbt). Field-service, logistics, or other operational SaaS domains. Prior experience as a senior or lead engineer responsible for guiding technical direction. Location: Remote (UK-based) with occasional collaborative team meetups. Right to Work: Applicants must currently have the legal right to work in the UK. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time. Compensation Additional Information WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US Laid back but focused: We offer a flexible, collaborative work environment and a passion for developing innovative, best-in-class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers. Impact-driven: We care deeply and deliver services and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses. Trust & Inclusion: We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust and mutual respect. RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED Competitive company pension scheme with employer match. Generous holiday allowance / flexible time off plus UK bank holidays. Enhanced maternity, paternity, and parental leave policies. Ongoing learning resources. Comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) providing free 24/7 mental health, legal, and financial guidance. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY WorkWave is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees in accordance with the Equality Act 2010. Don't meet every single requirement? Studies show that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. If you feel you could make a great impact in this role, we encourage you to apply anyway!

Our core data platform is owned by the team that built it. You'll build on top of it—and where data or infrastructure is holding an agent back, you'll have the standing to propose the change and drive it.

What You'll Do

From Customer Need to Product Superpower

  • Own the Outcome: Start from the customer, and stay with it until the agent is answering their needs better

  • Build Agents and Tools: Build production agents and the tools they call—retrieval, multi-step workflows, action-taking—on Amazon Bedrock, with Bedrock AgentCore as our runtime and tools exposed over MCP (Model Context Protocol).

  • Turn Serving Layers Into Capability: Our semantic layer and service APIs are where customer needs are already expressed. Your job is turning them into endpoints and tools an agent can wield well—and knowing which metrics and entities it should reach at all.

  • Shape the Experience, Not Just the Endpoint: How an answer arrives—its speed, its confidence, its explanation, the next step it offers—is the product. A technically correct response a customer ignores is a failure.

    • Prove It and Make It Felt

    • Measure Groundedness: Build the eval harness—labeled test sets, groundedness and hallucination rates you can put a number on, and CI gates that stop a regression before it ships.

    • Measure What Customers Got: Adoption, feedback, intent—then report realized impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up.

    • Diagnose and Iterate: Instrument the tracing that shows why an answer was wrong, turn each failure mode into a specific fix, and ship again. This loop is the job, not a phase of it.

      • Deliver

      • Ship and Operate: Own the serving path—MCP endpoints, latency, cost per response, caching, and runtime guardrails. Deployment and testing are part of the job, not a handoff.

      • Embed and Influence: Partner with Product Managers and engineers on which decisions an agent should support—and which it shouldn't. Where data or infrastructure limits what an agent can do, drive the change alongside the team that owns the platform.

Who You Are

The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions with the agent's help, not by whether it shipped.

The Agent Builder: You've taken an agent past the demo. You know the hard part is everything after it works once—coverage, grounding, cost, and the failure modes you only see at scale. You fix problems without waiting for a ticket.

The Experience Obsessive: You care how an answer lands, not just whether it was right. Trustworthy, fast, and legible beats clever.

We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you are a builder who cares about the "why" behind the code, we want to hear from you!

HOW WE WORK

We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next task faster for the whole team. The leverage is in the verification: the tests, CI gates, and typed interfaces that make agent-written code safe to merge.

What You"ll Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years building production software or data-intensive systems used by real customers, with strong Python skills—including at least one LLM or agent feature you shipped to production users.

  • AWS & Agent Stack: Hands-on AWS experience, ideally Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. Equivalent agent runtimes transfer, but we build on AWS and you'll be productive faster if you have prior exposure.

  • Agent Engineering: Orchestration, tool and function design, context assembly, and multi-step workflows—you've made the design calls, not just the prompt calls.

  • Retrieval & Domain Grounding: You've built retrieval over real business data, you can explain how context gets selected and why an answer was wrong, and you have enough SQL and metric fluency to catch an agent answering with the wrong number.

  • Evaluation & Iteration: You've built or owned an eval loop for a generative system—labelled sets, regression gates, and a number you could defend when someone asked whether it got better.

  • Product Sense for AI: You have opinions about how an agent should behave—when to answer, when to ask, when to refuse, how to show its work—and you've shipped those opinions, not just argued them.

  • Measurement & Narrative: You've quantified what an agent actually delivered for users—adoption, task success, decision quality—and presented it to people who were never going to read your traces.

  • Working With Agents: You've used coding agents on real production work, you can tell correct output from merely plausible output, and you invest in the harnesses that make the next task faster.

title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
description: SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. Nos chiffres clés : 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA. 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique. Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network. 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute. Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. ▪️ À propos du poste Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise. Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous. Les missions : Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine). Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS). Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée. Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu. Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle. Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord. Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act). S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts. Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR. ▪️ Le profil idéal 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...) Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A) Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA Un plus Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…) Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini), Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks ▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence. ▪️ Tes conditions de travail Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine. Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération). Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant. ▪️ Le processus de recrutement Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence. An overview of this role

As a Senior Backend Engineer in GitLab’s Platform Enablement organization, you will help make GitLab easier to deploy, validate, and operate across environments. This team is centered on two major areas: Cloud Native deployment guidance and ephemeral environments.

You’ll help shape GitLab’s next generation of self-managed deployment guidance as Reference Architectures evolve toward a model based on deployment patterns, workload characterization, component requirements, topology guidance, and scaling principles.

You’ll also help improve production-like ephemeral environments so teams can validate changes earlier, test against infrastructure and deployment conditions that more closely reflect real-world operation, and reduce drift between development, CI, and production. description: About the Job: LaunchDarkly is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Experimentation team. The Experimentation team is building one of the company’s most strategic product areas: a platform that helps leading engineering organizations move beyond intuition and make product decisions with real statistical confidence. Sitting at the intersection of large-scale systems, data science, and user experience, the team is creating a best-in-class experimentation product that lets customers set up, manage, and analyze experiments with ease while still earning the trust of even the most rigorous data teams. From warehouse-native analysis to experimentation workflows built on top of LaunchDarkly’s massive feature management scale, this team is tackling ambitious technical problems with visible customer impact and a clear opportunity to define the future of modern software experimentation. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design and operate the services that power this product, contribute to technical direction, and help deliver new functionality to customers. You will work closely with product managers, designers, data scientists, and engineers across LaunchDarkly to solve complex, data-intensive problems with meaningful customer impact. Responsibilities: Design, build, and operate scalable backend services and APIs that power LaunchDarkly’s Experimentation product. Own backend components across their lifecycle, including technical discovery, design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement. Build and evolve systems supporting experiment setup, event data ingestion, metric computation, results processing, and results presentation. Contribute to architectural decisions and technical proposals, making thoughtful trade-offs around scalability, reliability, performance, cost, and maintainability. Partner with product managers, designers, data scientists, and adjacent engineering teams to translate customer needs and product goals into reliable technical solutions. Collaborate with Data Platform, Warehouse Integrations, SDK, and other teams on shared data flows, services, and cross-team dependencies. Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes. Improve observability, testing, deployment safety, operational processes, and the reliability of the systems you build. Participate in the team’s on-call rotation and take ownership of production systems in a you-build-it-you-run-it culture. Support teammates through thoughtful code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and informal mentorship. Qualifications: 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building and operating backend services in production. Fluency using AI tools in software engineering workflows, including the judgment to direct, evaluate, and validate AI-generated output. Experience designing and delivering customer-facing systems that are scalable, reliable, observable, and maintainable. Strong programming experience in Go or a comparable backend language such as Python, Rust, or C++. Our team is using Go. Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, APIs, data modeling, or data-intensive services. Familiarity with analytical, operational, or warehouse data stores such as ClickHouse, Postgres, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, or equivalent technologies. Experience diagnosing production issues and improving system reliability through metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and other observability practices. Experience working in a cloud environment and with infrastructure-as-code or equivalent deployment and operations tooling. Ability to take an ambiguous problem from discovery and scoping through design, implementation, launch, and ongoing operation. Clear, thoughtful communication and a collaborative approach to working with technical and non-technical partners. Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, analytics, data platforms, or similarly data-intensive products. About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Experimentation team.

The Experimentation team is building one of the company’s most strategic product areas: a platform that helps leading engineering organizations move beyond intuition and make product decisions with real statistical confidence.

Sitting at the intersection of large-scale systems, data science, and user experience, the team is creating a best-in-class experimentation product that lets customers set up, manage, and analyze experiments with ease while still earning the trust of even the most rigorous data teams.

From warehouse-native analysis to experimentation workflows built on top of LaunchDarkly’s massive feature management scale, this team is tackling ambitious technical problems with visible customer impact and a clear opportunity to define the future of modern software experimentation.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design and operate the services that power this product, contribute to technical direction, and help deliver new functionality to customers.

You will work closely with product managers, designers, data scientists, and engineers across LaunchDarkly to solve complex, data-intensive problems with meaningful customer impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate scalable backend services and APIs that power LaunchDarkly’s Experimentation product.
  • Own backend components across their lifecycle, including technical discovery, design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement.
  • Build and evolve systems supporting experiment setup, event data ingestion, metric computation, results processing, and results presentation.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical proposals, making thoughtful trade-offs around scalability, reliability, performance, cost, and maintainability.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, data scientists, and adjacent engineering teams to translate customer needs and product goals into reliable technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with Data Platform, Warehouse Integrations, SDK, and other teams on shared data flows, services, and cross-team dependencies.
  • Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes.
  • Improve observability, testing, deployment safety, operational processes, and the reliability of the systems you build.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation and take ownership of production systems in a you-build-it-you-run-it culture.
  • Support teammates through thoughtful code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and informal mentorship.

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building and operating backend services in production.
  • Fluency using AI tools in software engineering workflows, including the judgment to direct, evaluate, and validate AI-generated output.
  • Experience designing and delivering customer-facing systems that are scalable, reliable, observable, and maintainable.
  • Strong programming experience in Go or a comparable backend language such as Python, Rust, or C++. Our team is using Go.
  • Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, APIs, data modeling, or data-intensive services.
  • Familiarity with analytical, operational, or warehouse data stores such as ClickHouse, Postgres, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience diagnosing production issues and improving system reliability through metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and other observability practices.
  • Experience working in a cloud environment and with infrastructure-as-code or equivalent deployment and operations tooling.
  • Ability to take an ambiguous problem from discovery and scoping through design, implementation, launch, and ongoing operation.
  • Clear, thoughtful communication and a collaborative approach to working with technical and non-technical partners.
  • Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, analytics, data platforms, or similarly data-intensive products.

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $191,800 - $263,670**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $172,600 - $237,270**

  • Build: Design agent architectures, write prompts, integrate with external systems (Salesforce, Samsara platform, Customer Success tools), and write clean Python code that the team can maintain.
  • Test: Define success criteria and evaluation frameworks before you write the first line of code. Build automated test suites that cover real-world scenarios, edge cases, and known failure modes.

  • Embed with the Commercial Customer Success team to understand what Customer Success Managers actually do — their workflows, their friction points, and the customer moments that move the needle
  • Get fluent in Samsara's platform, data model, and existing Customer Success tooling stack
  • Define success metrics and an evaluation framework for the first agent on the roadmap — before you write a single line of code

In your first 90 days

  • Ship the first production agentic solution that meaningfully improves customer outcomes that lead to revenue retention and/or growth
  • Build the monitoring and iteration loop from day one — so you have a clear signal on what's working, what's drifting, and what needs to change
  • Spec the second agentic solution to detect and mitigate risk within accounts and start building, applying lessons from the first
  • Provide an estimated start date for the value gap detection and product consultation — identifies underutilization and leads product consultations via text or call.

By the end of your first year

  • Own a portfolio of three or more production agentic solutions running reliably in the Commercial Customer Success motion — and a clear maintenance cadence that keeps them current as the product and playbooks evolve
  • Demonstrate the impact of agentic solutions on reduced customer time to value, reduced time spent detecting and resolving risks, and increased retention
  • Have a track record of improving solutions after launch: performance improvements measured in real customer outcomes, not just benchmark scores
  • Be the go-to expert at Samsara for customer-facing agentic AI development — advising Customer Success leadership on what to build next, what to retire, and how to evaluate ideas before committing to them
  • Help define what great looks like for ing at Samsara, setting a standard others can build on towards using AI to expand the pipeline

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production LLM-based agents or automations
  • Python proficiency and a track record of connecting AI to external systems: CRMs, APIs, customer data, and operational tools
  • The discipline to define what success looks like before you start building — and an eval framework that catches problems before your users do
  • A genuine curiosity about Customer Success workflows and customer problems, not just the technical challenge
  • Intellectual honesty about what AI can and can't do well — and the judgment to design guardrails and fallback paths accordingly
  • 3+ years of software engineering or technical experience, with at least 1 year working hands-on with LLMs or AI agents in a production environment
  • Experience in a B2B SaaS environment

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Direct experience with Anthropic Claude or similar LLM APIs
  • A background working with or alongside a Customer Success or Revenue Operations team
  • Experience building regression test suites or eval frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar CRM and Customer Success platforms

title: Product Engineer
description: Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more . Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment. What You'll Do This is a senior role for someone who has already shipped products real people love and is ready to own entire product surfaces from idea to impact. You'll be tasked with a large variety of projects. We're still small enough that engineers are expected to have a wide skillset and go from idea conception to feature success. We're looking for product engineers, people whose instinct is to ask "what should we build and why" before "how do we build it." You're technical enough to ship the whole thing yourself, but your superpower is product judgment, user empathy, and taste. You have strong opinions about product details — loading states, empty states, the copy on a button, and you notice friction others miss. raw.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You'll Do

This is a senior role for someone who has already shipped products real people love and is ready to own entire product surfaces from idea to impact.

You'll be tasked with a large variety of projects. We're still small enough that engineers are expected to have a wide skillset and go from idea conception to feature success. We're looking for product engineers, people whose instinct is to ask "what should we build and why" before "how do we build it." You're technical enough to ship the whole thing yourself, but your superpower is product judgment, user empathy, and taste. You have strong opinions about product details — loading states, empty states, the copy on a button, and you notice friction others miss.

Most of the things we work on are parts of the core product (an end-to-end pipeline for building computer vision projects spanning image ingestion to annotation to training and deployment), but from time to time we're also working on things like integrating marketing and sales tools, automating internal processes, and open source projects.

You'll help set the roadmap, not receive it. You'll be expected to advocate for which projects are the highest priority, contribute directly to strategy decisions, and bring engineers and users along with you. If you need a rigid list of tasks spelled out in a multi-month roadmap, this role won't be a good fit.

Example Projects

  • Identifying a flow our users quietly hate and redesigning it end-to-end.

  • Next-generation model-assisted labeling.

  • Streamlining our onboarding flow.

  • Expanding our annotation tool to support new functionality (like polygonal annotations for image segmentation).

  • Creating a filtering interface so our users can mix and match their images based on metadata like the time of day they were captured, the GPS location, or custom tags they've applied.

  • Integrating the core app with external APIs for things like outsourcing annotation tasks and analyzing deployed model performance.

  • Deeper integrations with our other products like Roboflow Universe and our REST API.

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

You will directly be working with our Engineering Lead and a team of Engineers.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is fully distributed. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

The target compensation for this role is $165,000 - $195,000.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • $350/mo AI Tools stipend

  • $150/mo team lunch stipend

  • $500/one time home office stipend

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (6+ hours)

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team and don't currently have in-house recruiters. You will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don't be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a day or two.

Introduction Phase:

  • [30m] Meet with hiring manager for introduction to assess overall mindset and skillset.

  • [30m] Team interview on product and business skills.

  • [60m] Collaborate with a Roboflow engineer to ideate and begin building a project with Roboflow.

Build with Roboflow:

  • You will build a small project with Roboflow to showcase your technical and product skills.

Project Demo:

  • [45m] Meet with your hiring manager or our CTO to demo your project

Final Interviews:

  • [45m] Meet with Head of Operations for a culture discussion.

  • [60m / Optional] Meet with CEO.

We call at least 3 references in the final stage of the process. We love it when one of your references is a customer or client you’ve worked with!

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing "Subscribe" to operations@roboflow.com. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere—and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Manager Media Solutions | Campaign (m/f/d)
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

What we offer you:

  • Work-life-balance: Teamwork and personal collaboration in the office are central to us, but we also offer a regular remote work day for added flexibility. In addition, you can compensate for overtime.
  • Vacation mode on: You receive 26 days of paid leave plus an additional 4 compensation days.
  • Wellbeing first: Health benefits and dedicated Mental Health Awareness Days put your health and well-being front and center.
  • Practice makes perfect: Grow through our diverse training programs and leverage internal career initiatives for your personal development across the WPP network.
  • More than just a job: Look forward to unforgettable team events, exclusive employee discounts, and many more highlights.
  • Be yourself: Everyone is warmly welcome here – diversity and equal opportunities are at the core of who we are.

 

 

This is what you move:

As Manager Media Solutions | Campaign (m/f/d), you are responsible for the operational planning, coordination, and activation of digital campaigns for our key global client Roche. Your primary focus is on programmatic activations across CTV, Video, and DOOH. Based in the Media Solutions Unit Switzerland, you will work closely with Client Leads, Programmatic Specialists, local and international WPP teams, as well as publishers and technology partners.

  • Campaign Activation: Independently coordinate and activate programmatic campaigns with a clear focus on CTV, Video, and DOOH.
  • International Campaign Roll-outs: Support the execution of multinational campaigns across various markets, working closely with local WPP teams to identify the best publishers, ad inventories, and activation opportunities.
  • Setup, Monitoring & Optimization: Campaign setup in relevant DSPs and activation platforms is in your hands, along with continuous delivery monitoring and data-driven performance optimization.
  • Partner & Client Team Coordination: Act as a central interface with publishers, media vendors, and technology partners while advising client teams on feasibility checks and activation strategies.
  • Reporting & Insights: Derive actionable insights from campaign reports and share best practices across involved teams.
  • Processes & Innovation: Actively document and enhance activation processes, drive competency growth in Programmatic, CTV, and DOOH, and contribute to evaluating new technologies as well as international projects.

 

 

The following qualities distinguish you:

  • Programmatic & Media Experience: Solid professional experience in digital media, programmatic advertising, campaign management, or ad operations – ideally within an agency, media owner, or adtech environment.
  • Platform & AdTech Know-how: Hands-on experience with at least one leading DSP (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, Adform) along with a strong understanding of digital advertising ecosystems and adtech infrastructure.
  • CTV & DOOH Specialization: Prior exposure to Connected TV (CTV), Digital Video, and/or Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH), combined with an enthusiasm for cross-channel digital campaign formats.
  • Organization & Project Management: Strong organizational skills, a structured and solution-oriented work approach, and ease in managing complex campaign workflows.
  • Stakeholder Management & Team Spirit: Excellent communication skills, analytical thinking, and a collaborative mindset for cross-market teamwork in an international environment.
  • Language Skills: Business-fluent English (written and spoken) for daily international collaboration; good German skills are a welcome plus.

Furthermore you are: #problem-solver #team-player #hands-on-mentality

If this job sounds exciting to you, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't have every qualification listed above.

 

Life at WPP Media:

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

description: Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes. Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together. About the Business Applications Team The Business Applications org builds and operates the internal systems that keep Thumbtack running at scale: Salesforce-centered workflows, admin tooling, and the integrations that connect teams across the company. We're now expanding that foundation into a broader internal platform for AI-enabled work — shared APIs, reusable integration patterns, and safe, auditable capabilities for business-critical actions. We work directly with the business teams who depend on these systems, turning complex operational needs into software that's easier to run, extend, and automate responsibly. The challenge Agents can already take action inside Thumbtack's internal systems. The harder problem is making that trustworthy: giving business teams a way to configure what agents are allowed to do, review and correct their work, and see clearly what happened and why. Without that, automation stays stuck in pilots. This engineer owns the product surface that turns agent capability into something teams will actually rely on for business-critical work — and the services behind it. What you’ll do Design and build the interfaces business teams use to configure agents, review their work, approve or correct actions, and understand what happened and why. Build observability and evaluation tooling that makes agent behavior legible — where it succeeded, where it failed, and whether a change made things better. Work across the stack, from React and TypeScript through service code and data models, owning features end to end through build, test, launch, and iteration. Partner directly with the business teams who use what you build; translate ambiguous operational problems into working software. Own the full lifecycle of your work, including monitoring and post-launch improvement. In order to be successful, you must bring 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong frontend skills with React and TypeScript, including complex application state and data-dense interfaces. Solid backend engineering ability. We use Go, PHP, and Python, and we expect strong engineers to pick up a new language. Working knowledge of relational and non-relational data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, or similar). Real product judgment: you can look at a workflow, decide what to build, and say what to cut. Interest in the problems that come with non-deterministic systems — uncertainty, partial failure, and designing for human correction rather than assuming a correct answer every time. Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, close your own knowledge gaps, and deliver in an evolving environment. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. Location This position is remote within the United States. In this role you will work with the team to build a scalable and secure platform and build customer-facing features that enable security and engineering teams to stop threats in their place! This is a rewarding opportunity for someone who is obsessed with customer success, passionate about simplification, and eager to dive deep into technology best practices. Lead and participate actively in agile development processes, code reviews, and technical strategy discussions. Address technical debt proactively, continually improving our codebase and technical stack Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field 7+ years of professional backend development experience Solid knowledge of Go, Python, or an equivalent programming language Experience in API development, PostgresQL database design or SQL query performance optimization Experience building and scaling distributed, highly available systems Strong problem-solving skills, a self-starter mentality, and a track record of technical ownership. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in fast-paced, agile environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Django, FastAPI or another Python web framework Experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure (EKS / RDS / S3 / SQS / EC2 / IAM /Lambdas) Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $180,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more. ABOUT EXTRAHOP ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise. Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues. Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done. Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo. Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. BENEFITS Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Location

This position is remote within the United States. Living in the Seattle, WA area is preferred but not required.

Position Summary

Join the Middleware team as a Sr. Software Engineer and help us build a fault-resilient, highly available, and customer-centric platform. In this role you will work with the team to build a scalable and secure platform and build customer-facing features that enable security and engineering teams to stop threats in their place! This is a rewarding opportunity for someone who is obsessed with customer success, passionate about simplification, and eager to dive deep into technology best practices.

Our services and features are written primarily in Python, Golang, TypeScript and React with a focus on security, scalability, stability and type-first design. The R(x) 360 Platform is built on AWS and GCP. It utilizes Terraform to define Infrastructure-as-Code and our services.   • Experience in API development, PostgresQL database design or SQL query performance optimization
  • Experience building and scaling distributed, highly available systems
  • Strong problem-solving skills, a self-starter mentality, and a track record of technical ownership.

  • Experience with Django, FastAPI or another Python web framework
  • Experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure (EKS / RDS / S3 / SQS / EC2 / IAM /Lambdas)

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.
