The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale. Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies. We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum. The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition. AI is fundamental to how we work AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at. What we're looking for: We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team building the software layer that connects EVs, chargers, solar, and batteries, so customers can optimize across fleets of homes and within each home, helping people manage their own energy while participating in grid-scale optimization. That means redesigning for speed, reliability, and broader coverage, evolving from controlling individual devices to optimizing the entire home, driveway included. AI is raising the bar for engineering leadership, and we need someone who leads people, not just process, who sets a standard the team is proud to clear, and tells leadership what it needs to hear. Our people are our most valuable asset, and we're looking for someone who leads like that. You will: Own the team's technical vision end to end, not just execute someone else's roadmap. You partner effectively with the product team to create an ambitious roadmap Define what "great" looks like, and refuse to settle for less. Your definition comes from past experiences of seeing great teams succeed Sit at the table with the CTO to shape strategy, product bets, and the roadmap for a business area we're still inventing Sit on the engineering leadership team, your job doesn't stop at your team's edge Lead the charge on AI adoption: find where it changes how we build, ship, and operate, and make it real, not theoretical Hire and grow people who make the team sharper, not just bigger. You are a coach to your teammates and help them reach their full potential Set expectations that are impossible to misread, then hold people to them with empathy and firmness, in equal measure Delegate like you mean it: give your team real ownership, not just tasks Push back on me (the CTO), on stakeholders, on plans that don't hold up, and do it in a way that builds trust, not friction Build relationships people actually rely on, across engineering, product, and leadership Be the person your team and peers come to think out loud with, no judgment, direct feedback both ways. This role will be right for you, if: 3+ years managing engineers, and you love it! You have values you won't compromise, even when it costs you something; tell us what those are! You are driven and ambitious, you push for hard goals and hold a high bar for yourself and everyone around you, consistently You have good instincts for when to keep it simple and when a clever solution is worth the complexity You've led remote, distributed teams and know what holds people together at a distance You think past your own team, comfortable shaping decisions at the engineering leadership-team level You’ve built AI products that have contributed meaningfully to the team's success You do your best work with your stakeholders in the room, not despite them Strong opinions, loosely held; you'll fight for a position, and drop it the moment the evidence says you're wrong Genuinely interested in the Energy shift, not just management as a craft, but this problem specifically Proactive to a fault; you spot the problem before anyone asks you to, and find ways to fix it People do better work around you; that's not an accident, it's how you lead and inspire You’ve made lots of mistakes in the past and can tell us what that taught you and how it shaped the manager you are today Bonus: you've worked across very different environments or company stages, and can tell us what that taught you Note: whether you want to stay hands-on as a player-coach or focus fully on management, both are welcome! What we offer: Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale. A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition. Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey. Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that. Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly. Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand. Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places. Flexible, human-first culture. Stipend for setting up your home office. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ A few things to note: Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles. Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here .

title: AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in Switzerland. In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy. Accountabilities Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts. AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations. Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors. Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures. Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs. Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch. Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives. E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions. Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment. Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts. Requirements Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition. Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms. Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions. Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products. Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work. title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (12 months FTC)
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As our organization continues to grow, attracting the best talent remains one of our highest priorities. To achieve this, it's essential to adapt by refining our recruitment strategies, upholding exceptional quality in our efforts, and embracing innovative recruitment methodologies. This is where our Talent Acquisition (TA) team plays a vital role.

In the role of Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a pivotal part in achieving the team's primary goal: attracting and hiring the right talent for Vinted while ensuring an outstanding candidate experience. Leveraging your expertise in recruitment, you will implement best hiring practices and collaborate with other team members on various projects. You’ll support either our Group & Marketplace business units, covering Community Support, Marketing, Finance, Legal and People, or our Vinted Pay & VintedGo business units, covering AML/Compliance, Business & Commercial and Logistics, with your focus shifting based on business needs.

If you're excited to contribute to our team's efforts in supporting our organization's growth, we would love to meet you.

Note. This role is offered as a 12-months fixed-term contract initially. There may be an opportunity for the position to be made permanent in the future, depending on business needs. 

In this position, you’ll 

  • Collaborate with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and ensure a seamless interview process to attract the right talent
  • Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, proactive candidate sourcing, conducting interviews, and extending offers
  • Build effective candidate talent pools through proactive sourcing, job boards, employee referrals, social media & employer branding campaigns etc
  • Guide hiring managers and interviewers on effective interview techniques and candidate evaluation methods
  • Track and report on key hiring metrics to ensure efficient recruitment processes, while providing a positive candidate and hiring manager experience
  • Gain exposure to talent acquisition initiatives by contributing to process improvement projects 
  • Stay informed about recruitment best practices and tools to continually improve the candidate experience

About you 

  • Previous experience as a Sourcer, Recruiter or Talent Acquisition Specialist specifically 
  • Proficiency in sourcing candidates using LinkedIn and other recruitment tools
  • Strong skills in candidate engagement and relationship building
  • Good understanding of assessment tools and interview evaluation techniques
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate across teams and levels
  • A proactive mindset and eagerness to learn and grow within the talent acquisition field

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€47.300—€63.900 EUR

title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load. You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache. You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies. You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end. You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong. You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises. You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over. English is your working language. German is a plus. What makes you stand out You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax. You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model. You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama. You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it. The team We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action. We are not filling a seat. title: Head of Consulting (Sales & New Business) (80–100 %)
description: Schweizer Engineering für die Software von morgen. novu baut keine Lösungen von der Stange, sondern Individualsoftware, die zum Geschäft unserer Kunden passt. Wir definieren, entwickeln, betreiben und erweitern sie, alles im Haus und alles in der Schweiz, mit rund 50 Leuten in Zürich und Bern. novu gehört zur Union Group AG, einer Gruppe von Schweizer Agenturen für digitale Kommunikation. Software entsteht mit AI immer schneller. Umso mehr zählt, wer versteht, was Kunden wirklich brauchen, und wer ihr Vertrauen über Jahre gewinnt. Genau dafür bist du da: Als Head of Consulting verantwortest du das Neugeschäft von novu, führst unser Consulting-Team und prägst, wie wir beraten. Du berichtest an den CEO und arbeitest im Führungsteam eng mit CTO und Head of Operations zusammen. Arbeiten kannst du wahlweise von Zürich oder Bern aus. Was du bei uns machst Du verantwortest das Neugeschäft: Du baust eine belastbare Pipeline auf, gehst aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zu, führst Pitches und schliesst Aufträge ab. Du kennst deine Zahlen und steuerst danach. Du betreust einige Schlüsselkunden selbst und berätst Geschäftsleitungen auf Augenhöhe. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team baust du bestehende Kundenbeziehungen aus und ziehst die Schwesteragenturen der Union Group AG bei, wo sie deinen Kunden weiterhelfen. Du führst das Consulting-Team: Du rekrutierst, gibst klares Feedback, führst die Standortgespräche und entwickelst die Beratungskompetenz jeder Person gezielt weiter. Du prägst, wie novu berät: Du setzt Standards für Angebote, Kundenführung und eine schlanke Projektführung und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden. Mit CTO und Head of Operations stimmst du Prioritäten und Kapazitäten ab, damit wir halten, was wir verkaufen. Gemeinsam mit dem CEO entwickelst du Angebot und Preismodelle weiter, gerade dort, wo AI verändert, wie Software entsteht und was Kunden dafür bezahlen. Den Einsatz von AI im Consulting treibst du selbst voran. Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung und Business Development rund um Software, Digitalprojekte oder IT-Dienstleistungen, idealerweise in einer Agentur. Du hast nachweislich Neugeschäft gewonnen und grössere Mandate selbst abgeschlossen. Führungserfahrung: Du hast ein Team geführt, idealerweise Consultants oder Projektleiterinnen und Projektleiter, und Menschen spürbar weiterentwickelt. Erfahrung in der Beratung von Geschäftsleitungen. Ein Netzwerk in der Schweizer Wirtschaft, auf das du aufbauen kannst, ist ein grosses Plus. Eigene Erfahrung in der Leitung von Software- oder Digitalprojekten. Du weisst, wo solche Projekte kippen und was sie kosten, und bist damit bei Kunden und im Team glaubwürdig. Unternehmerisches Denken: Du argumentierst mit Zahlen, kalkulierst sauber und verhandelst souverän. Du begeisterst dich für AI, probierst neue Werkzeuge selbst aus und kannst einschätzen, wie sie Beratung und Softwareentwicklung verändern. Ein professionelles, verbindliches Auftreten, stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Du hast deinen Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder bist bereit, hierher zu ziehen. Was wir bieten Eine Schlüsselrolle im Führungsteam von novu mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Ein Engineering-Team von rund 30 Leuten, das umsetzt, was du verkaufst. Den Rückhalt einer Gruppe von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden in vier Agenturen, mit der du Kunden ganzheitlich beraten kannst. 5 Wochen Ferien, flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten. Dabei bist du die verlässliche Ansprechperson deiner Kunden, vom ersten Gespräch bis in den Betrieb. Arbeiten kannst du wahlweise von Zürich oder Bern aus.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du berätst Marketingverantwortliche, Fachverantwortliche und Geschäftsleitungen zu ihren digitalen Vorhaben. Du machst technische Möglichkeiten verständlich, zeigst Handlungsoptionen auf und schaffst fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen.

  • Du betreust ein eigenes Kundenportfolio und entwickelst langfristige Kundenbeziehungen. Du verstehst die Ziele und Herausforderungen deiner Kunden, erkennst Potenziale und begleitest sie über den Launch hinaus in Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du trägst zum Neugeschäft bei: Du baust bestehende Kunden aus, wirkst bei Offerten und Pitches mit und ziehst die Schwesteragenturen der Gruppe bei, wo sie deinem Kunden weiterhelfen.

  • Du leitest mehrere Software- und Digitalprojekte parallel, von der Offerte bis zum Go-live. Dabei verantwortest du Umfang, Termine, Budget und Qualität und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden, Entwicklung, Design und Operations.

  • Du bringst Stakeholder mit unterschiedlichen Interessen zusammen, klärst Erwartungen und führst Entscheide herbei. Auch bei Zielkonflikten oder in schwierigen Projektphasen kommunizierst du klar, sprichst Risiken früh an und entwickelst tragfähige Lösungen.

  • Du prüfst gemeinsam mit Kunden und Team, wo AI und Automatisierung einen konkreten Mehrwert schaffen. Ideen machst du bei Bedarf mit einfachen Prototypen greifbar.

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als IT-Projektleiterin oder IT-Projektleiter in anspruchsvollen Software- oder Digitalprojekten, idealerweise im Agentur- oder Dienstleistungsumfeld. Du hast Projekte mit technischer Komplexität und anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern erfolgreich geführt.

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Entscheidungsträgerinnen und Entscheidungsträgern. Du kannst geschäftliche Anforderungen einordnen, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln und Empfehlungen überzeugend vertreten.

  • Ein professionelles, verbindliches Auftreten und Freude am persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, bereitest Gespräche sorgfältig vor und hältst Zusagen ein. So baust du Vertrauen und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.

  • Technisches Verständnis für Webentwicklung, CMS, APIs und Cloud-Umgebungen sowie ein Gespür für UX. Du sprichst auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklung und Architektur. Selbst Software entwickeln zu können, ist keine Voraussetzung.

  • Affinität für AI, Automatisierung und Vibe Coding: Du probierst neue Werkzeuge selbst aus und hast Freude daran, mit AI-Unterstützung Ideen und einfache Prototypen umzusetzen. Du kannst deren Nutzen und Grenzen einschätzen und weisst, wann du unsere Engineering-Teams einbeziehst.

  • Du kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch, mündlich wie schriftlich, verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse und hast deinen Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder bist bereit, hierher zu ziehen.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein eigenes Kundenportfolio mit Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung sowie individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die zu deiner Erfahrung und deinen Ambitionen passen.

  • Den Rückhalt einer Gruppe von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden in vier Agenturen, mit der du Kunden ganzheitlich beraten kannst.

  • 5 Wochen Ferien, flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten

About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is seeking a Senior Fullstack Engineer (BE-leaning) interested in working across the stack to join our fully distributed engineering team to help us continue our impressive growth from 2+ million daily active users to beyond! Our stack primarily includes Node.js, TypeScript, React.js and SQL.

As an engineering team, we design and build scalable systems using a service-oriented and event-driven architecture that serve millions of daily users and some of the largest youth and amateur sports organizations in the world. Our team values collaboration in a remote culture, so we regularly participate in pair sessions and virtual team swarms to stay connected and improve the team and company.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop engaging experiences for our millions of users across our mobile and web applications.

  • Design and implement scalable apps and services, integrating these into an evolving unified product and system architecture.

  • Brainstorm and evaluate new product features in collaboration with the product and UX team.

  • Collaborate and pair with other developers to develop solutions and teach technical skills.

  • Contribute to our development standards within the team and across engineering to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for improvement

  • Champion and implement automated testing practices to uphold the dependability and stability of backend systems, while also taking ownership of the overall reliability of the team's services.

  • Actively engage in on-call responsibilities and contribute to incident management efforts.

  • Evaluate and test new technologies to help TeamSnap move faster or serve our users more effectively.

  • Help teammates overcome obstacles, resolve blockers, and complete work tasks.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, leading large projects on high-scale, distributed software systems as a software engineer

  • Proficient in full stack development with Node, Python, Golang, Ruby, Javascript utilizing React or similar.

  • Experience with direct usage of SQL and relational databases such as MySQL / GCP Cloud SQL along with migrations, profiling, and optimization of such databases.

  • Hands-on experience developing APIs, services for mobile applications and web clients at scale.

  • Successfully delivered complex projects including debugging problems that may span a number of systems.

  • Experience working with and architecting APIs, event streams, webhooks, etc.

  • Experience working within and towards a distributed system.

  • Extra points if you’ve built services for livestreaming, advertising, or subscriptions.

Compensation

Additional Information

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $150,000, inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

Total Rewards

• We're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool

• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)

• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family

• 401K to help you invest for the future

• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events

• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success

• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter

• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!

• TeamSnap Total Rewards

Working at TeamSnap

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

title: Principal Cloud Software Architect
description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! The Mission We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Architect to join our growing Cloud Native Applications team and lead delivery on Caylent's largest and most strategically important client engagements. The right candidate has deep expertise in designing and building applications, creating AI-first software solutions, and is energized by the scale, complexity, and stakes that come with our biggest accounts.. Your mission will be to work alongside and lead Caylent’s Software Engineers, Architects, Sales, and Project Managers to deliver for our largest and most complex customers. You’ll be hands-on with the latest technologies, operate confidently amid the ambiguity and competing priorities that large enterprise environments bring, and serve as a steady, senior presence — both for your team and in front of client leadership — when the stakes are highest. Your Assignment Lead software development project teams to deliver AI-first, production-ready solutions in environments with significant scale, technical complexity, and organizational complexity. Lead and own technical requirements gathering, technical decision making, backlog generation and refinement, and all architectural decisions - including where legacy systems, multiple integration points, or ambiguous requirements are in play. Lead discovery sessions with client stakeholders, including senior technical and business leadership to gather customer requirements and formulate them into a workable backlog. Build architecture diagrams to document, communicate, and defend your solution design to both engineering teams and client leadership. Apply your expertise in AI-first software development as a hands-on, contributing member of the technical team. Create, automate, and refine multiple levels of AI-driven testing. Coach and mentor teammates, provide guidance and assistance to software engineers and share practices for leading high-stakes engagements with peer Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers. Serve as the senior point of escalation on your engagement - identifying delivery risk, technical roadblocks, or relationship friction early, and stepping in to protect both the client relationship and the team. Own status reporting and communication with client leadership on your engagement, including presenting progress, risk, and roadmap in steering committees or business reviews. Collaborate with project managers, peers, and leaders to navigate client, technical, and team challenges with strong conflict resolution and leadership particularly across large, multi-stakeholder client organizations. Support pre-sales efforts through scope development discussions, contract document review, and client presentations when needed with particular focus on large or complex deals. Your Qualifications Core Consulting Qualifications Customer Experience Expertise in confidently addressing complex client questions, including from senior client stakeholders, and identifying gaps in requirements with proposed next steps. Focus on delivering clear, actionable solutions that meet client goals Collaboration Facilitate alignment across a wide range of stakeholders, technical priorities, and deliverables, including in organizationally complex client environments. Navigate differing, and sometimes competing, perspectives with professionalism to ensure shared understanding and progress. Communication Break down and communicate complex technical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences, including senior client stakeholders, in a clear, concise manner. Adapt communication style based on audience and context to improve clarity and decision-making. Technical Qualifications 8+ years of proven experience in software development and cloud-native systems. Experience managing professional services engagements and cross-functional projects, including engagements involving multiple stakeholders, legacy systems, or significant integration complexity. Strong background in established engineering practices and scalable architectures. Experience with more than one backend language such as Python, Node.js, C#, or TypeScript; and familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, MVC, or .NET. Broad expertise is a plus, but proficiency across every technology listed is not required. Learning and building with AI both for productivity and for enhancing client solutions. Deep experience and expertise building with AWS. Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL). Experience in API integrations across applications, vendors, and cloud environments. Understanding of modern application architectures including event-based systems, queues, microservices. Demonstrated ability to build credibility and trust with senior client stakeholders. Desire to integrate innovative technologies into development workflow. Proven ability to lead a workstream and support others while contributing individually, even under the added scale and visibility of large enterprise engagements.. Preferred Qualifications Degree in a computing-related field Experience with: UX/UI, LLMs, AgentCore, GenAI, automated testing, CI/CD, IaC Experience with large-scale system modernization or legacy migration Experience navigating enterprise IT governance processes (e.g., change advisory boards, security reviews, procurement cycles) Benefits Pay in USD 100% remote work Generous holidays and flexible PTO Competitive phantom equity Paid for exams and certifications Peer bonus awards State of the art laptop and tools Equipment & Office Stipend Individual professional development plan Annual stipend for Learning and Development Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture This role may require up to 25% travel, depending on business needs. NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time. At Caylent, we are committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated systems to assist with the screening and evaluation of applications to help match candidate qualifications with job requirements. These tools are designed to support — not replace — human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our trained recruitment professionals. If an AI or automated tool is used during your application process, it will only be in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and your information will be handled in a secure and confidential manner. If you have any questions, please contact talent@caylent.com Caylent is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at Caylent. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@caylent.com.

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Architect to join our growing Cloud Native Applications team and lead delivery on Caylent's largest and most strategically important client engagements. The right candidate has deep expertise in designing and building applications, creating AI-first software solutions, and is energized by the scale, complexity, and stakes that come with our biggest accounts..

Your mission will be to work alongside and lead Caylent’s Software Engineers, Architects, Sales, and Project Managers to deliver for our largest and most complex customers. You’ll be hands-on with the latest technologies, operate confidently amid the ambiguity and competing priorities that large enterprise environments bring, and serve as a steady, senior presence — both for your team and in front of client leadership — when the stakes are highest.

Your Assignment

  • Lead software development project teams to deliver AI-first, production-ready solutions in environments with significant scale, technical complexity, and organizational complexity.
  • Lead and own technical requirements gathering, technical decision making, backlog generation and refinement, and all architectural decisions - including where legacy systems, multiple integration points, or ambiguous requirements are in play.
  • Lead discovery sessions with client stakeholders, including senior technical and business leadership to gather customer requirements and formulate them into a workable backlog.
  • Build architecture diagrams to document, communicate, and defend your solution design to both engineering teams and client leadership.
  • Apply your expertise in AI-first software development as a hands-on, contributing member of the technical team.
  • Create, automate, and refine multiple levels of AI-driven testing.
  • Coach and mentor teammates, provide guidance and assistance to software engineers and share practices for leading high-stakes engagements with peer Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers.
  • Serve as the senior point of escalation on your engagement - identifying delivery risk, technical roadblocks, or relationship friction early, and stepping in to protect both the client relationship and the team.
  • Own status reporting and communication with client leadership on your engagement, including presenting progress, risk, and roadmap in steering committees or business reviews.
  • Collaborate with project managers, peers, and leaders to navigate client, technical, and team challenges with strong conflict resolution and leadership particularly across large, multi-stakeholder client organizations.
  • Support pre-sales efforts through scope development discussions, contract document review, and client presentations when needed with particular focus on large or complex deals.

Your Qualifications

Core Consulting Qualifications

Customer Experience

  • Expertise in confidently addressing complex client questions, including from senior client stakeholders, and identifying gaps in requirements with proposed next steps.
  • Focus on delivering clear, actionable solutions that meet client goals

Collaboration

  • Facilitate alignment across a wide range of stakeholders, technical priorities, and deliverables, including in organizationally complex client environments.
  • Navigate differing, and sometimes competing, perspectives with professionalism to ensure shared understanding and progress.

Communication

  • Break down and communicate complex technical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences, including senior client stakeholders, in a clear, concise manner.
  • Adapt communication style based on audience and context to improve clarity and decision-making.

Technical Qualifications

  • 8+ years of proven experience in software development and cloud-native systems.
  • Experience managing professional services engagements and cross-functional projects, including engagements involving multiple stakeholders, legacy systems, or significant integration complexity.
  • Strong background in established engineering practices and scalable architectures.
  • Experience with more than one backend language such as Python, Node.js, C#, or TypeScript; and familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, MVC, or .NET. Broad expertise is a plus, but proficiency across every technology listed is not required.
  • Learning and building with AI both for productivity and for enhancing client solutions.
  • Deep experience and expertise building with AWS.
  • Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  • Experience in API integrations across applications, vendors, and cloud environments.
  • Understanding of modern application architectures including event-based systems, queues, microservices.
  • Demonstrated ability to build credibility and trust with senior client stakeholders.
  • Desire to integrate innovative technologies into development workflow.
  • Proven ability to lead a workstream and support others while contributing individually, even under the added scale and visibility of large enterprise engagements..

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in a computing-related field
  • Experience with: UX/UI, LLMs, AgentCore, GenAI, automated testing, CI/CD, IaC
  • Experience with large-scale system modernization or legacy migration
  • Experience navigating enterprise IT governance processes (e.g., change advisory boards, security reviews, procurement cycles)

Benefits

  • Pay in USD
  • 100% remote work
  • Generous holidays and flexible PTO
  • Competitive phantom equity
  • Paid for exams and certifications
  • Peer bonus awards
  • State of the art laptop and tools
  • Equipment & Office Stipend
  • Individual professional development plan
  • Annual stipend for Learning and Development
  • Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

This role may require up to 25% travel, depending on business needs.

NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time.

At Caylent, we are committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated systems to assist with the screening and evaluation of applications to help match candidate qualifications with job requirements.
These tools are designed to support — not replace — human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our trained recruitment professionals.
If an AI or automated tool is used during your application process, it will only be in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and your information will be handled in a secure and confidential manner.
If you have any questions, please contact talent@caylent.com

Caylent is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at Caylent.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@caylent.com.

About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Juniper Square, you're a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and operates production systems powering core workflows for institutional financial clients. You bring deep technical expertise to your team, drive complex projects independently, and collaborate closely with Staff engineers, product, design, and QA to ship reliable, well-designed systems.

You'll join the Platform team, building the foundational infrastructure layer that powers all AI work at Juniper Square, both customer-facing (GPX) and internal automation. Every AI initiative at JSQ runs on top of this platform, spanning AI Gateway & Infrastructure, Governance & Security, Retrieval & Data Access, and Agent Framework.

What you'll do

Build & Operate Production Systems

  • Design, build, and ship production-quality systems, APIs, and services - from foundational platform capabilities to customer-facing product experiences

  • Own projects end-to-end: translating requirements into technical designs, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration

  • Build reliable, scalable, and observable systems that deliver value to customers and enable other engineering teams to move faster

  • Own the production health of the systems you build, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance, reliability, and issue resolution

  • Build reusable infrastructure, frameworks, tooling, and developer experiences that enable teams across the organization

  • Improve engineering velocity and operational quality through automation, documentation, and continuous improvements

Drive Technical Excellence

  • Contribute to technical design for complex projects, evaluating tradeoffs and proposing pragmatic implementation plans

  • Partner with product, design, and engineering to translate requirements into well-designed technical solutions

  • Help identify and reduce technical debt, reliability risks, and friction in the software development lifecycle

  • Collaborate with Staff and senior engineers to establish reusable patterns and raise engineering standards

  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and operational support

AI Fluency & AI-Native SDLC

  • Use agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development as a primary part of your workflow, deliberately choosing where AI versus traditional software is the right tool

  • Critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, edge cases, and regressions, shipping quality output regardless of how it was produced

  • Build or integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities in your domain where they add real value (e.g., evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows), with clear human-in-the-loop boundaries

  • Contribute to the team's evolving practices around AI-accelerated development, testing, and code review

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with product, design, QA, and cross-functional partners to meet timelines and align solutions to business goals

  • Provide clear, accessible technical context to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Domain Expertise

  • Grow into a subject-matter expert with a deep understanding of the data, workflows, and customer needs specific to that space

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in backend and/or full-stack software engineering

  • Strong backend engineering experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Pyramid, or Django

  • Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies such as AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, observability, and operating services in production

  • Comfort working full-stack when the problem calls for it (TypeScript/React experience a plus)

  • Ability to break down complex technical problems and deliver pragmatic, maintainable solutions

  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively across teams

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineering and cross-functional partners

  • Hands-on experience with AI-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment), and demonstrated AI Fluency: a deliberate point of view on when AI is (and isn't) the right tool, adapted code review practices for AI-generated code, and safeguards against over-reliance on AI tooling

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered systems in production (e.g., RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, evaluation workflows, guardrails, prompt/tool orchestration, or model observability)

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-evolving technical territory where best practices and patterns are still being established

Nice to Have

  • Background in financial services or fintech

  • Experience with API gateway/infrastructure, security & governance tooling, retrieval and data-access systems, or agent frameworks at production scale

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this role sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $220,000 and the Canadian base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $210,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

Role Description

As a Product Engineer at Dropbox, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of collaboration and file sharing. Your responsibilities will revolve around developing and enhancing our suite of Dropbox Products to deliver exceptional user experiences. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, turning innovative ideas into robust, scalable, and user-friendly features.

This year, Dropbox is on a mission to expedite the creation and implementation of AI-enable products by providing a comprehensive AI technology stack that facilitates speedy prototyping and reliable deployment of AI-driven functionalities.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Independently identify and deliver software solutions through a set of milestones spanning a specific product focus or a multi-component system
  • Write code alongside junior engineers, demonstrating hands-on technical leadership, understanding root causes, and leading by example.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and analysts to deeply understand user needs and develop products that meet those needs.
  • Develop and execute both short and long-term roadmaps, balancing business impact, user experience, and technical excellence.
  • Foster a positive team and company culture through mentorship, participation in interviews, and engagement in new initiatives.
  • Establish and nurture relationships with other engineering teams and collaborate effectively with other functions within Dropbox.

On-call work may be necessary occasionally to help address bugs, outages, or other operational issues, with the goal of maintaining a stable and high-quality experience for our customers.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering or related industry experience.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent technical experience.
  • Proven track record in identifying and delivering software solutions through a set of milestones spanning a specific product focus or a multi-component system
  • Developed and shipped large-scale web applications with a user-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency in building user-facing software and supporting systems and libraries for web and/or desktop platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contributions to open source projects or technical communities
  • Full-Stack Development
  • Technologies: MySQL, Python, Go, Java, Rust

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Kafka/AWS Integration Engineer to join a project focused on building and productionizing an event-driven middleware platform using Apache Kafka and AWS.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role where you will build the AWS side of the integration platform, with Salesforce serving as the initial event source. You will work alongside the Lead Integration Architect and within the Agile sprint process, implementing solutions based on an established architecture and prioritized backlog.

Responsibilities:

  • Provision and configure Amazon MSK clusters, Kafka topics, and schema registry.
  • Configure and maintain Kafka Connect and CDC source connectors.

  • Develop Java stream-processing applications to transform data between Kafka topics.
  • Build Java-based integration pipelines to deliver events from outbound topics to downstream systems.
  • Implement dead letter queues and error-handling patterns for reliable event processing.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and code coverage.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure using AWS CloudFormation, enabling the client's operations team to redeploy and manage the environment.
  • Work within the client's Agile/sprint process and collaborate closely with the Lead Integration Architect.

  • Professional experience building event-driven and Kafka-based systems.

  • Experience building and supporting production-grade integration pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of automated testing, CI/CD, and production-quality software development practices.
  • Comfortable working within an Agile/sprint environment under the direction of a client architect.
  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to transfer technical knowledge effectively to client engineering and operations teams.
  • Advanced written and verbal English communication skills.

Must Have:

  • Kafka clusters and topics
  • Kafka Connect
  • Change Data Capture (CDC)
  • Experience with Schema Registry, including schema versioning and evolution.
  • Strong experience with AWS serverless technologies, including:
  • API Gateway
  • AWS Lambda
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with AWS CloudFormation.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with automated testing and code coverage.
  • Experience building or supporting event-driven integration systems.
  • Comfortable working in an Agile/sprint environment under a client architect's direction.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills for technical knowledge transfer.
  • Advanced written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience implementing dead letter queues (DLQs) and error-handling patterns in event-driven systems. Kafka-AWS-Integration-Engineer.

title: Director, Engineering - Care
description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: Hims & Hers is on a mission to empower people to live healthier lives. The Care engineering team builds provider- and support-agent-facing web applications and the backend platforms behind our integrated Care Platform and pharmacy operations. You'll help build the next generation of tools for a modern, patient-centric model of healthcare. As Director of Engineering for Care, you'll own engineering strategy and delivery for the clinician and patient experience, from intake and consultation through prescription. You'll lead the team building clinical systems where speed has to coexist with patient safety, regulatory compliance, and auditability. You'll partner with product, design, data, clinical, pharmacy, and operations leaders, set the multi-year technical and organizational strategy, and develop the engineering leaders who will carry it forward. You Will: Own technical vision, architecture, and delivery for Care, including intake, consultation, clinician workflows, prescribing, care-team and support tooling, and the handoff to pharmacy. Define and deliver the engineering roadmap with product and design, balancing innovation, reliability, scalability, and quality. Lead the shift to a durable domain model with clear boundaries and enforced contracts, moving teams off direct cross-domain database access and toward APIs and published events. Ensure the platform meets requirements for patient safety, clinical guardrails, security, privacy (HIPAA), and state and federal regulation, including controlled-substance prescribing. Set and hold reliability standards (SLOs, incident response) for patient-critical flows. Lead the transition to an AI-first engineering culture, with AI-assisted development, review, and spec-driven workflows backed by measurable goals. Build and mentor engineering managers and technical leaders, with a focus on succession planning and a strong technical bench. Own staffing and organizational strategy, including hiring, headcount planning, and team structure as the domain evolves. Drive alignment across teams and partners, managing trade-offs between speed, technical debt, and innovation. Represent engineering in executive forums, translating strategy, status, and risk for senior stakeholders. You Have: 12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years managing managers or multiple teams in high-growth environments. A track record building and operating systems that handle clinical or other regulated health data, with working knowledge of HIPAA and compliance-driven design. Experience owning end-to-end user experiences with cross-functional product engineering teams. Strong grounding in modern service architectures (Spring Boot, Kotlin, PostgreSQL) and the judgment to guide design decisions in depth. Experience integrating third-party health and pharmacy systems, such as labs, e-prescribing networks, and pharmacy platforms. Ability to define and execute technical roadmaps tied to product vision and business outcomes. Strong communication skills and executive presence, translating between technical, clinical, and business stakeholders. A demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing engineering talent. Comfort making risk trade-offs where patient safety and speed conflict. Preferred: experience in telehealth, digital health, or other regulated clinical environments. Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights): Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 401k benefits with employer matching contribution Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address.
